Cambiar de forma te libera de <b>Polymor: Shapeshifting frees you from Polymorph and anything that slows or roots you: Frost Nova, Hamstring, Wing Clip, Concussive Shot, roots. If you're slowed in Cat Form, shift to bear or caster and back; you can go straight from one form to another. Each shift costs 55% of base mana (30% less with Natural Shapeshifter), so don't do it for every minor slow: save it to escape or to catch someone running. It doesn't remove stuns, fears or silences. In Forever forms are immune to Disarm, but if you get disarmed before shifting you stay disarmed, so shift first.
<b>Entangling Roots</b> (1,5 s, 30 metro: Entangling Roots (1.5 sec cast, 30 yards) holds an enemy in place; you can only have one target rooted at a time, and in Forever it now works indoors. Root the warrior or rogue, get out of their reach and cast Moonfire or Wrath, or heal. Damage can break roots, so don't hit them hard if you want it to last (Improved Entangling Roots lets it take 75% more damage). Cast Nature's Grasp before they arrive to root the first one who hits you; in Forever you can cast it in forms and indoors.
Para curarte, primero crea espacio (<b>E: To heal, first make space (Entangling Roots, Bash, War Stomp as a tauren), then drop form. Pop Barkskin (usable in any form; hits won't push back your casts), cast Regrowth or Rejuvenation and shift back to cat or bear. In an emergency, Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch is an instant big heal. Against a rogue, fake it: start the heal, cancel it with a step and cast it once they've used Kick. In Forever, with Furor, going back to Cat Form restores the energy you had plus what regenerated while you were out of form, so stepping out to heal doesn't leave you dry.
Con <b>Prowl</b> vas un 30 % más lento,: Prowl slows you by 30%, so approach from behind and take your time. Open with Pounce (2 sec stun, 3 with Brutal Impact) to chain hits with no response, or Ravage for the biggest hit. In Forever Feral Charge in Cat Form leaps you behind the target (8-25 yards, 30 sec): use it to get behind for Shred or to jump away. Against stealthed rogues and druids, Faerie Fire stops them from hiding; in forms it's free.
El druida no tiene un corte rápido en ga: Druids have no quick interrupt in Cat Form. As a bear, Feral Charge (8-25 yards, 15 sec) charges the target, roots them and interrupts their cast for 4 sec, and Bash stuns for 4 sec in melee (1 minute cooldown, 30 sec with Brutal Impact). When a healer is about to land a big heal, shift to bear, charge, then go back to cat. Every shift costs mana, so plan it.
En campos de batalla con bandera, el dru: In capture-the-flag battlegrounds, the druid is the best flag carrier. Outdoors, Travel Form (+40%); in Cat Form, Dash (+60% for 15 sec, 5 min cooldown) and Feral Swiftness. Every time you're slowed, shift. If they catch you, go bear (Dire Bear Form gives a lot of health and armor), use Barkskin and Frenzied Regeneration, and drink potions without leaving form (allowed in Forever). Run behind walls and pillars so casters lose sight of you, and heal there.
Cuando te concentran varios, pasar a oso: When several players focus you, bear form is your defense: much more armor and health. Frenzied Regeneration turns rage into health and Barkskin cuts physical damage by 20% for 15 sec. Berserk (Feral's final talent) removes fear and makes you immune to it for 15 sec: save it for warlocks and priests instead of using it on the opener. As a tauren, War Stomp works in forms and stuns everyone close to you.
En Classic, el gato salía y volvía a ent: In Classic, cats dropped and re-entered Cat Form to get free energy from Furor (powershifting). In Forever that no longer gives energy: Furor only restores what you had. Its replacement is Shifting Power: it turns mana into 40 energy without leaving form (16 sec cooldown, 8 with Improved Shifting Power; it costs the same as entering Cat Form). Use it when you drop below about 50 energy, never at full (it won't let you). Drink mana potions and Thistle Tea without leaving form to keep it going.
Como gato, ponte siempre detrás del jefe: As a cat, always stand behind the boss: Shred only works from behind, and you dodge frontal attacks. In Forever Omen of Clarity is baseline: when Clearcasting procs, spend it on your most expensive ability, usually Shred. Keep Rake and Rip up for Rend and Tear, and don't refresh Rip before it runs out.
En Forever el oso genera un 50 % más de: In Forever bear forms generate 50% more threat and get double rage from crits. Open with Faerie Fire (it now generates threat in bear), then Primal Bite on cooldown and Lacerate up to 5 stacks. On packs, Swipe (3 targets), and on big pulls Berserk makes Primal Bite hit 3. Maul replaces your next white hit and that hit no longer gives rage, so only use it with spare rage. Turn the boss to face away from the group; Growl (8 sec) to pick one back up and Challenging Roar if several get loose.
Bajar amenaza y salir a ayudar: Dropping threat and shifting out to help
Como gato, si te acercas a la amenaza de: As a cat, if you're getting close to the tank's threat, Cower (10 sec) drops a large chunk of threat without stopping your damage. If the group needs Rebirth or Innervate, drop form and cast them: with Furor, in Forever you keep your energy when you go back to cat and even regenerate it while out of form (except in bear, where it doesn't regenerate). No excuse not to help.
Como sanador, cura antes de que haga fal: As a healer, heal before it's needed: Rejuvenation on the tank right before the pull and on whoever is about to take damage. Don't refresh it early. In Forever HoTs from several druids stack and can crit, and Swiftmend no longer eats the Rejuvenation or Regrowth: use it every 15 sec as a quick burst heal. Wild Growth when several people are hurt, and Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch to save someone. Reflection keeps 50% of your mana regen going while you cast.
En Balance, un <b>Wrath</b> carga <b>Ecl: As Balance, one Wrath charges Eclipse and speeds up your next two Starfire casts: alternate like that. Spend Clearcasting on Starfire (Wrath doesn't consume it). When you have to move, use the time to refresh Moonfire and Insect Swarm, which are instant, instead of standing in a bad spot.
Pon las formas en teclas fijas y fáciles: Put your forms on fixed, easy keys (the stance bar or Shift+1...). With the macro /cast !Cat Form (same for Dire Bear Form), pressing it twice won't drop you out of form by accident.
Activa la Personal Resource Display en l: Turn on the Personal Resource Display in the combat options to see your mana while shifted, so you know how many shifts or Shifting Power casts you have left.
Macros de ratón encima para curar sin ca: Mouseover macros let you heal without changing target when you drop form: /cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Rejuvenation. Same for Regrowth and Remove Curse.
El Cooldown Manager de Forever ya funcio: Forever's Cooldown Manager already supports druids: keep Berserk, Barkskin, Nature's Grasp, Shifting Power and Bash in view.
Gira con el ratón (botón derecho) y muév: Turn with the mouse (right button) and move with the strafe keys: in Cat Form to get behind the target; carrying the flag, to never turn your back on your chaser.
Todas las técnicas, explicadas para cual: Every technique, explained for any class: Gameplay techniques

Es la base de todas las clases a distanc: This is the core of every ranged class (some streams call it «the L»). Open from range with your long shot: Aimed Shot (2 sec) or, as Marksmanship, Sniper Shot from 45 yards. When they close in, slow them with Concussive Shot and move away sideways with the strafe keys, not backwards: strafing keeps your full run speed, while backpedaling is far slower. Turn the camera with the mouse so the enemy stays in your front half, and you can keep firing instants (Arcane Shot, stings, Summon Hawk) on the move. Once you have range again, stop and shoot.
Sirve cuando el rival te persigue justo: Use it when the enemy is right behind you and outside your front half. While running away: jump, spin 180° in the air with the right mouse button, fire an instant (Concussive Shot or Arcane Shot) and turn back before you land. A jump keeps its momentum, so you lose no ground. In Forever it only works with instants: Auto Shot needs half a second standing still, so it never fires mid-air. Drill it on a training dummy until the turn feels automatic.
Salir de la zona muerta: Get out of the dead zone
Entre el alcance de melé y los 8 metros: Between melee range and 8 yards no shot works: that is the dead zone, and a warrior or rogue who stays there shuts down your damage. When they reach you: Wing Clip (50% slow for 10 sec), a few strafe steps and Concussive Shot as soon as you pass 8 yards. As Survival, Improved Wing Clip can root them and Strider Kick gives you 30% speed for 3 sec to get out. Turn on «Auto Attack/Auto Shot» in Options and the game swaps between melee and shooting by itself.
Desde el 15 de octubre, <b>Auto Shot</b>: Since 15 October, Auto Shot only fires after half a second standing still, as in original WoW. While kiting the rhythm is: stop, the shot goes off, strafe until the next one, stop again. If you never stop, no Auto Shot fires and you lose much of your damage. A Forever bonus: Auto Shot keeps firing while you cast Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot, so long casts cost you no shots.
En Forever las trampas se ponen en comba: In Forever traps can be placed in combat, and you can have one frost and one fire trap out at once. While running, drop Frost Trap at your feet and run straight: the enemy steps on it and is slowed by 60% across the whole ice patch. Against a chaser, Freezing Trap at your feet freezes them on arrival (any damage breaks it). Marksmanship combo: Scatter Shot (4 sec disorient, your next hit breaks it), then place the trap between you so they walk into it when it ends. With Entrapment (Survival) they are also rooted for 5 sec.
Hacerse el muerto para soltar al rival: Feign Death to shed your attacker
<b>Feign Death</b> hace que quien te ata: Feign Death makes your attacker lose you as a target and cancels many spells aimed at you. Time it: as a mage or warlock finishes a long cast, or to make a rogue find you again. In Classic it was mostly used to drop combat so you could lay traps; in Forever you no longer need that, since traps work in combat. Careful: it can fail, and if you leave it on for 6 minutes you really die.
La mascota no es solo daño: es tu primer: Your pet is not just damage: it is your first line of control. When a melee goes for you, send it in with /petattack. As Beast Mastery, Intimidation makes its next hit stun for 3 sec: that is your window to run. A bird of prey with Mine! disarms warriors and rogues for 3 sec. Before Freezing Trap or Scatter Shot, pull your pet back (/petfollow) or it will break the control. Against a warlock or hunter, killing their pet first is often right.
Manda la mascota primero y espera dos o: Send the pet in first and wait two or three hits before shooting, or the mob turns on you. If it still switches to you, Disengage (it drops twice as much threat as in Classic) and let the pet take it back. On packs, the pet cannot hold everything: only use Multi-Shot and Volley once it has them.
Sin mascota (o si muere), el kiting te s: Without a pet (or when it dies), kiting saves you: Concussive Shot, a couple of shots, and when it closes in, Frost Trap at your feet and strafe away. If it reaches melee, Wing Clip and step out of the dead zone. In dungeons it lets you keep an uncontrollable mob busy while the tank handles the rest.
En mazmorras, <b>Feign Death</b> borra t: In dungeons, Feign Death wipes your threat: use it if a mob turns on you, then keep shooting. While leveling, if your pet dies and you cannot finish the fight, feign to leave combat, revive the pet and try again. If the group is about to wipe, you can survive and help everyone back up.
<b>Freezing Trap</b> es tu control en ma: Freezing Trap is your dungeon crowd control. In Forever it works in combat: drop it where your assigned mob will walk, or at your feet if it comes for you. Nobody should hit it: any damage breaks the ice. Clever Traps (Survival) makes it last 30% longer.
En banda o mazmorra, quédate quieto: cad: In raids and dungeons, stand still: every time you move, Auto Shot waits another half second. In Forever Aimed Shot no longer interrupts it (you keep shooting while casting), so cast it on cooldown and fit Arcane Shot and stings in between.
Mueve el personaje con W y S y pon el de: Move with W and S, put strafe on A and D, and always turn with the right mouse button, not the keyboard: it is much faster and you need it for the jump shot.
Pon los instantáneos y las trampas en te: Bind your instants and traps close to WASD (1-5, Q, E, R, F, Shift + number) so you can use them without stopping.
Macros de mascota: una tecla con <b>/pet: Pet macros: one key with /petattack and another with /petfollow plus /petpassive to pull it back before a crowd control. In Forever, Aggressive mode lives in the pet tab of your spellbook.
Activa en Opciones «Auto Attack/Auto Sho: Turn on «Auto Attack/Auto Shot» in Options so the game switches between melee and shooting for you (it also works on gamepad).

La base del mago (en algunos directos lo: The mage's bread and butter (some streams call it «the L»). Open from max range with your long cast: Frostbolt (40% slow) or Frostfire Bolt. Once they get close, stop casting long spells: Frost Nova, move away sideways with the strafe keys (strafing keeps full speed; backpedaling is much slower) and finish with instants: Ice Lance, Fire Blast, Cone of Cold. Turn the camera with the mouse so the enemy stays in your front half. Once you have range again, another Frostbolt.
Si el rival va justo detrás de ti, salta: If the enemy is right behind you, jump while running, spin 180° in the air with the right mouse button, fire an instant (Ice Lance, Fire Blast or Cone of Cold, which needs them in front) and turn back before you land. The jump keeps its momentum, so you lose no ground. It only works with instants; spells with a cast time can't be cast while jumping or moving.
El golpe fuerte del mago de Escarcha. 1): The frost mage's big hit. 1) Frost Nova (or a Frostbite freeze). 2) A few strafe steps out of their reach. 3) Frostbolt, and just before it finishes, Ice Lance: thanks to Forever's spell batching both land together and use the freeze. Ice Lance deals triple damage to frozen targets and snapshots it, so it hits in full even if the freeze breaks right after. Shatter adds crit chance against frozen targets. Any damage breaks Frost Nova, so don't apply damage over time first.
Aprovechar Fingers of Frost: Make the most of Fingers of Frost
<b>Fingers of Frost</b> hace que tus dos: Fingers of Frost makes your next two spells treat the target as frozen, but any spell spends it. If it procs while you are casting something long that isn't Frost, cancel it (moving is enough) and fire Ice Lance. Spell batching lets you squeeze more out of it: start Frostbolt and press Ice Lance at the end of the cast; both resolve together on the same charge.
<b>Blink</b> te lleva 20 metros <b>hacia: Blink moves you 20 yards the way you are facing and frees you from stuns and roots. Save it for the rogue's opener, the warrior's charge or a root, not for a reflex escape. Before you press it, turn the camera with the mouse toward where you want to go (if you are strafing, you would blink sideways). If they are chasing closely, jump, turn in the air toward your escape route and Blink. If something is in the way, it carries you less far.
Con dos rivales, <b>Polymorph</b> al que: With two enemies, Polymorph the one you won't kill first and fight one-on-one. Against a single enemy, the sheep buys time for Frost Nova and Cone of Cold to come back, or a few seconds to eat and drink; but they heal very fast while polymorphed, so don't use it if they were almost dead. Any damage turns them back, and repeated sheeps last less each time (diminishing returns). It only works on humanoids and beasts.
Que no te retrasen el hechizo: Don't get your cast pushed back
Cada golpe que recibes mientras lanzas r: Every hit you take while casting delays the spell (spell pushback): against a melee, a Frostbolt may never go off. New in Forever: while Ice Barrier is up, hits don't push your casts back, so put it up before the fight and keep it rolling. As Fire, Burning Soul gives fire spells a 70% chance to ignore pushback. With no shield, use instants until you regain range.
Mira la barra de lanzamiento del rival y: Watch the enemy cast bar and save Counterspell for heals or big spells, not the first one you see: some players start a cast and cancel it to bait your interrupt (a juke). With Improved Counterspell (Arcane) it also silences for 4 sec. Against hunters and other casters, break line of sight (LoS): get behind a pillar, a tree or a corner; their cast fails and they have to come to you.
El plan de Escarcha para subir: <b>Frost: The Frost leveling plan: Frostbolt from range and another while it walks in slowed. If it reaches you, Frost Nova, a few strafe steps back and Ice Lance while it's still frozen. Finish with Fire Blast or your wand instead of wasting an expensive Frostbolt on a nearly dead mob.
Agrupa a varios enemigos, espera a que s: Pull several mobs, let them bunch up and cast Frost Nova; step back a few yards and drop Blizzard on them (Improved Blizzard slows them). Before they reach you, Cone of Cold and step away again. If they surround you, Blink through them and keep going. Only do it with full mana and an escape plan: one mob too many and it falls apart.
En grupo, tu trabajo es la oveja: <b>Pol: In groups your job is the sheep: Polymorph the mob your group marked before the pull and recast it when it fades. Don't use Blizzard, Cone of Cold or Arcane Explosion near the sheep: any damage wakes it.
No quitarle la atención al tanque: Don't pull threat off the tank
Empieza a lanzar cuando el tanque ya ten: Start casting once the tank has the mob, not before. If a mob turns on you, stop casting. Frost Channeling cuts the threat of your Frost spells by 30%; Burning Soul does it for Fire and Arcane Subtlety for Arcane. Counterspell on enemy casters helps the group, though it causes a lot of threat.
Tu maná se regenera con el Espíritu, per: Your mana regenerates from Spirit, but stops for 5 seconds every time you spend mana. Finishing with your wand lets it kick back in sooner. In long fights: Mana Agate (or a higher gem), then Evocation (8 sec channel). Between fights, conjured water; always carry some for the group.
Movimiento con W y S, desplazamiento lat: Move with W and S, strafe on A and D, and always turn with the right mouse button: keyboard turning is too slow for jump-turns.
<b>Frost Nova</b>, <b>Blink</b>, <b>Ice: Put Frost Nova, Blink, Ice Lance and Fire Blast next to WASD (Q, E, R, F, 1-4): they are what you press while running.
Macro de oveja al foco: <b>/cast [@focus: Focus sheep macro: /cast [@focus] Polymorph. Set the second enemy as focus and sheep it without changing target.
Macro de corte: <b>/stopcasting</b> y de: Interrupt macro: /stopcasting with /cast Counterspell below it, so you can interrupt even mid-cast.

Stun + burst (Hammer of Justice into Jud: Stun + burst (Hammer of Justice into Judgement)
Con <b>Seal of Command</b> puesto, acérc: With Seal of Command up, get close and press Hammer of Justice (10 yards, stuns up to 6 sec depending on rank). Right after, Judgement: against a stunned or incapacitated target it deals double damage. Follow with Holy Strike and your swings while the stun lasts. Judgement and Hammer of Justice only reach 10 yards: if you get kited, they won't land. In Forever Judgement doesn't use up the seal, so you can judge again 10 sec later without reapplying it.
Controlar para poder curarte: Control them so you can heal
Crowd control for a heal / Repentance: Crowd control for a heal / Repentance
Tu cura más grande, <b>Holy Light</b>, e: Your biggest heal, Holy Light, is slow and easy to interrupt. Cast it while the enemy is controlled: after Hammer of Justice, or after Repentance (Retribution talent, 20 yards, incapacitates humanoids for up to 6 sec). Any damage wakes a Repentance target, so don't hit or judge them until you're done healing. Remember that when you do go back in, Seal of Command's Judgement also doubles against incapacitated targets.
Blessing of Freedom cuando te frenan: Blessing of Freedom when they slow you
Al paladín le falta movilidad, y los mag: Paladins lack mobility, and mages, hunters and warriors thrive on slowing you. Blessing of Freedom makes you immune to roots and slows for 10 sec (20 sec cooldown). Don't use it early: wait until they land Hamstring, Frost Nova, Crippling Poison or Concussive Shot, then use it to close in and stun. With Pursuit of Justice (Retribution) you're always 15% faster.
Amagar la cura para que gasten el corte: Fake the heal to bait the interrupt
Un corte (Kick, Pummel, Shield Bash, Cou: An interrupt (Kick, Pummel, Shield Bash, Counterspell) locks the whole Holy school, and nearly everything you have is Holy: get interrupted and you have no heals for several seconds. When a rogue or warrior is on you, start Holy Light and cancel it by stepping halfway through the cast. If they burn the interrupt on the fake, you can heal safely. Forever has spell batching: if you both press at almost the same moment, both effects can go through.
Contra lanzadores y cazadores, cúrate fu: Against casters and hunters, heal out of their sight. Put a pillar, a house or a rock between you and them: if they can't see you they can't cast on you, and they have to walk into your 10 yard range. Also use it to let your mana come back or to wait out their effects.
<b>Divine Protection</b>, <b>Divine Shie: Divine Protection, Divine Shield, Blessing of Protection and Templar's Bulwark apply Forbearance for 1 minute, which locks out all the others. Divine Shield (12 sec) is the best one: in Forever you can keep attacking, but at half damage, so use it to heal, Cleanse yourself or wait for help. Blessing of Protection only stops physical attacks: great against a rogue or warrior, useless against a mage.
No aturdir a quien ya está aturdido: Don't stun a target that was just stunned
Contra jugadores, los aturdimientos que: Against players, stuns repeated in a short time last half as long, then a quarter, until the target is immune for a while. If a rogue on your side just used Kidney Shot, your Hammer of Justice may barely last: save it for when the target breaks away or to stop a heal. Repentance is a different family (incapacitate) and isn't shortened by stuns.
Desde el 40, el talento <b>Twist of Ligh: From level 40, the Twist of Light talent makes Classic-style seal twisting simpler: when you swap Seal of Command for Seal of Righteousness you keep an Echo of the old seal, and your next swing applies both. The comfortable way is to swap right after a weapon swing lands, so you have the whole gap of a slow weapon to do it. On the next swing go back to Seal of Command and repeat. It costs mana (though the talent cuts seal costs by 20%): do it on bosses or long fights, not on everything.
Tu maná solo se regenera con Espíritu a: Your mana only regenerates from Spirit once 5 sec have passed since you last spent any (the five-second rule). While leveling, spend early in the fight (seal, Judgement, Holy Strike) and let your weapon finish the job: if the next swing will kill, don't press anything. Don't refresh your seal before it runs out, only use Consecration on two or more enemies and, if you keep running dry, swap Might for Blessing of Wisdom.
Para tanquear, <b>Righteous Fury</b> enc: To tank, keep Righteous Fury on and Seal of Fury up. Open with Judgement: with Seal of Fury it forces the enemy to attack you for 4 sec, and doubles as a second taunt. Drop Consecration under the pack to hold all of them and use Holy Strike on cooldown. If you're doing damage and not tanking, turn Righteous Fury off.
Empezar la cura antes del golpe: Start the heal before the hit
Como Holy, <b>Holy Light</b> tarda en la: As Holy, Holy Light has a long cast: start it before the boss's big hit, not once the tank is already low. If it turns out you don't need it (the hit misses or the tank is topped), cancel it by stepping before it finishes and you spend no mana. Use Flash of Light for light damage and Holy Shock to save someone right now.
Como Retribution, pega siempre por la es: As Retribution, always hit from behind: from the front the enemy can parry and block, and you eat its cleaves. Solo leveling, place yourself so Consecration (8 sec to deal its full damage) sits under every enemy, and skip it if you're about to move or they'll die sooner.
Gira con el botón derecho del ratón y de: Turn with the right mouse button and set A/D to strafe: it keeps you on the target's back and lets you cancel a heal with one step without turning.
Hammer of Justice y Judgement en teclas: Put Hammer of Justice and Judgement on neighbouring keys (say Q and E): the combo has to come out back to back without looking.
Macro de cura sobre ti sin cambiar de ob: Self-heal macro that keeps your target: /cast [@mouseover,help][@player] Flash of Light. Do the same for Blessing of Freedom and Cleanse to use them on an ally by hovering.
Seal of Command y Seal of Righteousness: Put Seal of Command and Seal of Righteousness on two comfortable side-by-side keys: when seal twisting you'll swap seals every swing.

Pícaros (<b>Kick</b>), guerreros (<b>Pum: Rogues (Kick), warriors (Pummel), mages (Counterspell) and shamans (Earth Shock) wait for you to start a cast so they can interrupt it and lock that spell school for a few seconds. Start a Flash Heal or Mind Blast and cancel it halfway by taking a step or with a /stopcasting macro. If they burn the interrupt on the fake, you get a window to cast for real. Don't be predictable: sometimes cancel early, sometimes late, sometimes not at all. A cancelled cast costs no mana.
Casi todo lo que te hace daño a distanci: Almost everything that hurts you at range needs to see you. Put a pillar, rock or corner between you and a mage, warlock or hunter and their spell won't go off or gets cut. Against another priest it's your best answer to Mana Burn (3 sec cast). Fight near obstacles, make the enemy walk around them to see you, and hit them with instants (Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, Shadow Word: Death) as they come around. When healing, check that you can still see your ally: the corner that protects you can hide them too.
Contra un guerrero o un pícaro, el plan: Against a warrior or rogue, the plan is to deal damage without letting them hit you. Shield up with Power Word: Shield before they arrive and get Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague ticking. When they reach you, Psychic Scream, then back off and cast Mind Blast while they run. When they come back, Mind Flay slows them by 50%, but it only reaches 20 yards and roots you in place while you channel. Move sideways (strafe) and turn with the mouse so you never show them your back. In Forever wands need you to stand still for 0.5 sec before shooting, so they're no good for finishing someone on the run.
<b>Psychic Scream</b> hace huir 8 s a ha: Psychic Scream sends up to 5 enemies within 8 yards running for 8 sec, on a 30 sec cooldown (26 with Improved Psychic Scream). Don't use it on the first hit: save it for when two melee players are on you, when a nearby healer is casting (the fear interrupts the cast), or after the enemy has used their fear break (Will of the Forsaken, Berserker Rage...). Damage can break the fear early, so don't chase the runner with spells: use those seconds to heal, shield or get away. In battlegrounds, running into an enemy group and casting it (a fearbomb) buys your team several seconds.
En Forever <b>Fear Ward</b> lo aprenden: In Forever every race learns Fear Ward: it lasts 3 minutes on a 3 minute cooldown. Put it up before fighting a warlock, another priest or a warrior, not once you're already running in terror: you can't cast while feared. In a group, give it to whoever hurts the team most by running off (your healer or your main damage dealer). A sharp opponent will try to pop it with a lesser fear (for example Intimidating Shout) before the one that matters: if you see it drop, the next fear will land.
Cada golpe que recibes retrasa el hechiz: Every hit you take pushes back the spell you're casting (spell pushback). While Power Word: Shield holds, damage won't delay you: cast your heals or Mind Blast with the shield up. Afterwards you get 15 sec of Weakened Soul, so pick your moment. As Discipline, Soul Warding removes its 4 sec cooldown and Renewed Hope trims Weakened Soul by 5 sec when you heal that target with Flash Heal or Penance. Martyrdom gives you 6 sec of pushback-free casting after taking a critical hit.
<b>Dispel Magic</b> es instantáneo y qui: Dispel Magic is instant and removes 2 magic effects: harmful ones from an ally (a warlock's fear, Polymorph, magic roots) or helpful ones from an enemy (Power Word: Shield, Blessing of Freedom, Ice Barrier...). Strip the enemy's shield before your burst; if an ally is polymorphed or feared, free them right away. It costs 18% of base mana, so remove whatever changes the fight most first. Against healers and casters, Mana Burn (30 yards) wins long duels: cast it when they can't interrupt you.
El Espíritu solo te devuelve maná si lle: Spirit only regenerates mana once you've gone 5 seconds without spending any (instants count too); mana per 5 sec from gear always ticks. In Forever Meditation keeps 50% of it going while you cast, as does Spirit Tap after a kill. Don't heal for the sake of it: if the tank is fine, let a few seconds pass and let Renew or Prayer of Mending do the work. While leveling, finishing with your wand instead of another spell gets your regen back sooner.
Contra golpes que sabes que van a llegar: For hits you know are coming, start a Heal or Greater Heal on the tank before the hit so it lands right after. If the tank is still nearly full as the cast finishes, cancel it by moving or with /stopcasting: you spend no mana and don't restart the five-second rule. That cuts overhealing and makes your mana last much longer. For big scheduled hits, Inner Focus makes the Greater Heal free and adds crit chance.
Curar genera amenaza contra todos los en: Healing generates threat on every enemy in the fight. At the start, let the tank land a few hits before your first big heal. If something comes for you, use Fade (30 sec cooldown; in Forever it drops far more threat than in Classic) and move toward the tank so they can pick it up without chasing. As Shadow, Mind Blast causes a lot of threat: don't open with it before the tank does. Silent Resolve cuts the threat of all your spells by 30%.
Dónde ponerte en un jefe: Where to stand on a boss
Quédate lejos del jefe pero dentro del a: Stay far from the boss but within healing range (40 yards), somewhere you can see the tank and the rest of the group. Never stand in front of the boss (cone attacks and breaths) or right behind a dragon (tail swipes). If the boss fears, put Fear Ward on the tank before the pull and keep empty space behind you so you don't run into other mobs. Holy Nova only reaches 10 yards and Prayer of Mending jumps 20, so the group has to be stacked to get value from them.
<b>Shackle Undead</b> deja quieto a un n: Shackle Undead holds one undead in place for up to 50 sec (one at a time, and any damage frees it): mark it and tell the group not to hit it. Mind Control (20 yards, 3 sec cast) takes over a humanoid for up to a minute; use it to pull one out of a pack or to turn it on its friends. Psychic Scream is a last resort in dungeons: fleeing mobs can bring more back with them.
Con <b>Improved Mind Flay</b>, cada golp: With Improved Mind Flay every tick hits 20% harder than the last, and Dark Inspiration only triggers on a full channel, so don't clip it to cast something else. If Mind Blast comes off cooldown mid-channel, press it just before the channel ends and the game queues it up to fire right after. Keep Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague up so Shadow Weaving doesn't fall off.
Gira con el botón derecho del ratón y mu: Turn with the right mouse button and move sideways with the strafe keys (Q and E by default). Walking backwards (backpedaling) is slow and is the most common way to lose a PvP fight.
Pon <b>Power Word: Shield</b>, <b>Psychi: Put Power Word: Shield, Psychic Scream, Fade and Dispel Magic on keys next to your movement keys (1-5, Shift+number), not on a bar you have to click.
Macro de ratón encima (mouseover) para c: Mouseover macros let you heal without changing target: /cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Flash Heal. Do the same for Dispel Magic and Power Word: Shield. Add a macro with just /stopcasting for fake casts.
Activa el Cooldown Manager en las opcion: Turn on the Cooldown Manager in Forever's options and keep Psychic Scream, Fear Ward, Shadow Word: Death and Inner Focus in view so you know at a glance what's ready.
En Forever hay cola de hechizos y los he: Forever has a spell queue and resolves spells in batches (spell batching): press your next spell slightly before the current one ends instead of mashing the key.

Desde el sigilo, <b>Cheap Shot</b> aturd: From stealth, Cheap Shot stuns for 4 sec and gives 2 combo points. Build points with your generator and, right as the stun is about to end, not before, cast Kidney Shot (up to 6 sec with 5 points at rank 2). Casting it while the first stun is still running wastes control time. As Subtlety, Premeditation gives you 2 points before the opener (spend them within 20 sec) for a longer chain.
No repetir el mismo control: Don't repeat the same kind of control
Contra jugadores, cada control del mismo: Against players, each control effect of the same type you repeat in a short time lasts half as long, then a quarter, and then the target is immune until about 15-20 sec pass without it (that is how Classic works; Forever keeps it and has announced no changes). So after your stuns, switch type: Gouge is an incapacitate and Blind is a different family, so they still last their full duration. If someone else already stunned your target (say with Hammer of Justice), your Kidney Shot may come out shortened: wait or use another control.
<b>Gouge</b> incapacita 4 s (más con Imp: Gouge incapacitates a target facing you for 4 sec (longer with Improved Gouge), and any damage breaks it. Use it to stop a spell when Kick is on cooldown, or to buy time: after Gouge, stop attacking, pool energy and walk to their back. When they wake up you're not in front of them, and you can follow with Backstab or your next Kidney Shot. Watch your poisons and bleeds: if they're still ticking, they break Gouge.
<b>Blind</b> desorienta hasta 10 s a 10: Blind disorients for up to 10 sec at 10 yards and needs Blinding Powder. Any damage breaks it, so don't cast it with Garrote, Rupture or damage poisons still running. After Blind, step away and use a bandage (First Aid) or go back into Stealth to open again with Cheap Shot. Against a target that heals or still has its escape ready, hold it until they spend it.
<b>Kick</b> corta el hechizo y bloquea e: Kick stops the cast and locks that school for 5 sec (10 sec cooldown; Improved Kick also silences for 2 sec). Don't spend it on the first cast: good casters start one and cancel it (juke) to make you miss. Wait until the bar is past halfway on the heal, fear or Polymorph. Don't leave it to the very last moment: Forever has spell batching and the spell may still land. If Kick is on cooldown, Gouge interrupts too.
<b>Vanish</b> (Flash Powder, 5 min de re: Vanish (Flash Powder, 5 min cooldown) puts you back in stealth and clears slows. It's not just for running: if the fight turns, Vanish, step away a couple of yards, let energy refill and open again with Cheap Shot. As Subtlety, Preparation (10 min) finishes the cooldown on Vanish, Blind, Sprint and Evasion: it's a whole second fight.
Sap y Distract para elegir la pelea: Sap and Distract to pick your fight
En Forever, <b>Sap</b> no rompe tu sigil: In Forever, Sap doesn't break your stealth: if two enemies travel together, Sap one (up to 45 sec, out-of-combat humanoids only) and open on the other. Distract turns enemies around and also lowers their stealth detection for 10 sec: use it to slip past a guard or behind a player unseen. With Sap, note that using it on a PvP-flagged target flags you too.
Lleva <b>Crippling Poison</b> en una de: Run Crippling Poison on one weapon against runners: 70% slower for 12 sec. If you get slowed, Sprint with Improved Sprint removes the slow when you press it. Against mages and hunters, stick to their back: give them room and they'll slow you and get away. Against melee, Evasion (and Ghostly Strike as Subtlety) lets you win the trade.
Por detrás el enemigo no puede parar ni: From behind the enemy can't parry or block your attacks, and Backstab, Ambush and Garrote require it. In groups, stand behind the target, never between it and the tank. Solo leveling, if a hard hitter is facing you, Gouge and get behind it.
La energía sube igual de rápido aunque e: Energy refills at the same rate whether full or not, so sitting at max wastes it. Before a key moment (refreshing Slice and Dice, opening from stealth or popping Adrenaline Rush) let it build, but don't sit at 100. At 5 combo points don't use a generator: spend with a finisher first.
Un pícaro con buen equipo le quita fácil: A well-geared rogue easily pulls aggro off the tank early in a fight. Let the tank hit for a few seconds before you start and use Feint (10 sec cooldown) on cooldown on bosses. If the enemy turns to you, Evasion buys time while the tank takes it back; if someone is about to die, Vanish drops your threat.
En mazmorras, un humanoide con <b>Sap</b: In dungeons, a Sapped humanoid is out for 45 sec and, in Forever, you stay in stealth. Agree with your group: you Sap the marked target and the tank pulls the rest. If it wakes early, Gouge or Blind buys a few seconds.
Muchos enemigos de mazmorra curan o lanz: Plenty of dungeon enemies heal or cast dangerous spells. Agree with the warrior or another rogue who interrupts what, so you don't burn two Kicks on one cast. Always kick heals and fears; small damage spells only when spare.
Gira con el botón derecho del ratón y us: Turn with the right mouse button and use A/D to strafe: it's how you circle a target to reach its back without wasting time.
Kick, Gouge, Kidney Shot, Blind y Vanish: Put Kick, Gouge, Kidney Shot, Blind and Vanish on keys you can hit without leaving WASD (1-5, Q, E, R, F or Shift+number). Don't put them where you have to look at your bars.
Macro de foco para controlar a un segund: Focus macro to control a second enemy without switching targets: /cast [@focus] Blind. Forever supports focus macros.
Sprint, Evasion y el vendaje, en Shift+t: Put Sprint, Evasion and your bandage on Shift+key: they are emergency buttons, and this way you won't waste them by accident.

<b>Earth Shock</b> corta el hechizo y bl: Earth Shock interrupts the cast and locks that school for 2 sec (20 yards, 6 sec cooldown). Save it for the big heal, the fear or the Polymorph, not for damage. Careful: it shares a cooldown with Frost Shock, so if you just slowed someone you have no interrupt. Watch the enemy's cast bar and, against players who fake cast, kick late, when there's no time left to cancel. If you only want the interrupt, rank 1 costs almost no mana and locks out just like the top rank.
<b>Grounding Totem</b> atrae hacia sí el: Grounding Totem pulls in the next harmful spell cast on you or a nearby ally and breaks when it eats it. It has a 15 sec cooldown (13 with Guardian Totems) and does nothing against area spells. Drop it the moment you see a Polymorph, Fear, Mind Control or big Frostbolt start: the spell is wasted on the totem. Against a mage, dropping it before they open makes them waste their first spell. It's instant, so bind it to a key you can hit without thinking.
<b>Tremor Totem</b> quita miedo, control: Tremor Totem removes fear, charm and sleep from your group within 30 yards; in Forever it lasts 5 minutes. Drop it BEFORE the fear: you can't cast while feared, and the totem doesn't free you instantly, only on its next pulse. Against warlocks and priests, put it down as soon as the fight starts. Totems have 5 health and die to one hit, so don't leave it at the enemy melee's feet; put it behind you or out of their sight.
En Forever no se puede alternar tótems d: In Forever you can't alternate totems of the same element to stack their effects (totem twisting): drop one per element and choose well. Totemic Projection (instant, 30 yards, 1 minute cooldown; 40 sec with Elemental Reach) moves all your active totems at once: use it to pull Tremor Totem out of enemy reach, carry your totems to where the fight moved, or put Earthbind Totem on the doorway or ramp the enemy has to cross. It costs 25% of base mana, so if you don't need everything moved, Totemic Recall (refunds some mana) and re-dropping just what you need can be cheaper.
No tienes aturdimientos: tu control es f: You have no stuns: your control is slowing. Frost Shock slows by 50% for 8 sec and Earthbind Totem slows every enemy within 10 yards (15 sec cooldown; with Earthbound it also roots them for 5 sec when dropped). Drop Earthbind Totem between you and the enemy, strafe away, and once they're far enough cast Lightning Bolt or heal. With Improved Ghost Wolf, Ghost Wolf is instant and works indoors, for escaping or chasing.
<b>Purge</b> quita 2 efectos mágicos bue: Purge strips 2 helpful magic effects from an enemy (30 yards, 10% of base mana). Use it before your damage window on Power Word: Shield, Ice Barrier or paladin blessings like Blessing of Freedom, which lets them ignore your slows. It's cheap: if the target is stacked with buffs, cast it twice in a row before you go in.
Con un arma lenta de dos manos, cada gol: With a slow two-hander, every white swing matters. A spell with a cast time resets your swing timer; instants don't. So fire Stormstrike, your shocks and the instant Lightning Bolt from 5 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon right after a white hit, not in the middle of the swing. Your PvP burst: Stormstrike (buffs your next Lightning Bolt or Earth Shock by 20%), the instant Lightning Bolt and Rage of the Farseer, once the enemy has used their defensive cooldowns.
Si te están pegando, cura con <b>Lesser: If you're being hit, heal with Lesser Healing Wave (1.5 sec) instead of Healing Wave, and save Nature's Swiftness + Healing Wave for when you're about to die. Against a rogue or warrior, start a heal and cancel it with a step so they burn their interrupt, then cast the real one. Healing Focus (Restoration) gives you a 70% chance not to lose cast time when hit. If the attacker is a caster, break line of sight behind an obstacle before healing.
Tótems en el sitio justo: Putting totems in the right spot
Los tótems actúan alrededor de donde est: Totems work around where they stand, not around you. In Forever Strength of Earth, Windfury, Grace of Air and Flametongue reach the whole raid, not just your party, but players still have to be close: drop them among the melee next to the boss. Searing Totem shoots 20 yards, so place it close. If the boss moves, carry your totems over with Totemic Projection instead of recasting them. Mid-fight, drop them one by one: Call of the Elements has a 3 sec cast.
En mazmorras, los enemigos que curan o l: In dungeons, enemies that heal or cast nasty spells get interrupted in turns: you with Earth Shock (6 sec), the rogue with Kick, the warrior with Pummel. Agree on the order before the pull. Careful: Earth Shock causes a lot of threat, so unless you're tanking, let the tank build a lead first. If you want to slow something with less threat, Frost Shock generates less, but remember they share a cooldown.
<b>Chain Heal</b> cura a 3 objetivos y c: Chain Heal hits 3 targets and each jump heals half as much as the previous one. Cast it on the most injured player who has other injured players nearby, not on someone off on their own. Cast on a party member, it only jumps within your party. With Riptide, start on that target: a Chain Heal cast directly on them heals 25% more. Healing Wave for the tank; Lesser Healing Wave for emergencies.
Tu Espíritu solo devuelve maná tras 5 s: Spirit only regenerates mana after 5 sec without spending any, and dropping totems counts as spending. Don't drop all 4 totems on mobs that will be dead in 10 sec. Water Shield (Restoration) gives back 2% of your max mana when you're hit or land a crit. After the fight, Totemic Recall refunds 25% of the mana of your active totems. Save Mana Tide Totem (12 sec, 5 min cooldown) for when the whole group is running low.
Pega al jefe por detrás: así no te alcan: Hit the boss from behind: frontal attacks won't reach you and your swings can't be parried. Without Rockbiter Weapon, Spirit Weapons cuts your threat by 30%; with Rockbiter Weapon it raises it by 30%, which is what you want if you end up tanking a dungeon. If a big Windfury Weapon crit puts you above the tank, ease off for a moment: you have no threat drop.
Prepara la barra de tótems con tres jueg: Set up your totem bar with three sets: Call of the Elements for solo play, Call of the Ancestors for groups and Call of the Spirits for PvP (with Tremor or Grounding). Out of combat you drop them all in one go.
<b>Grounding Totem</b>, <b>Tremor Totem<: Put Grounding Totem, Tremor Totem, Earth Shock and Purge on keys you can hit without looking, next to your movement keys. In PvP a totem half a second late is useless.
Macro de ratón encima para cortar al san: A mouseover macro lets you interrupt the healer without changing target: /cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Earth Shock. For heals, the same with help instead of harm.
<b>Totemic Projection</b> se apunta en e: Totemic Projection is ground-targeted like an area spell: practice out of combat so you can place it quickly and exactly where you want.
Como Enhancement, un temporizador de gol: As Enhancement, an on-screen swing timer from an addon shows you when your white hit has just landed so you can cast right after it.

La versión del brujo de correr de lado (: The warlock's take on strafing away (some streams call it «the L»): apply your instant damage-over-time effects and back off while they tick. As Affliction: Bane of Agony, Corruption (instant with Improved Corruption 5/5; 2 sec cast without it), Siphon Life and Curse of Exhaustion (30% slow; more with Amplify Curse first). Move away sideways with the strafe keys, turning the camera with the mouse to keep them in front, and refresh whatever expires. In Forever a Bane and a Curse are separate, so you can have both.
<b>Fear</b> (1,5 s de lanzamiento, 20 me: Fear (1.5 sec cast, 20 yards) sends the enemy running; damage can break it, and with lots of effects on them it breaks sooner. Use it to gain distance or to cast something long in peace, and rely on effects you already applied instead of stacking more. Reapplied quickly on the same target, it lasts less each time (diminishing returns). Watch out for Undead (Will of the Forsaken) and warriors in Berserker Stance, who can break it.
Contra cazadores y lanzadores, la línea: Against hunters and casters, line of sight is your shield. Step out from behind a pillar, a house or a tree, apply an instant effect and duck back: your damage keeps ticking and they can't cast at you. They'll have to come closer, right where your Fear and your demon are waiting.
Death Coil en el momento justo: Death Coil at the right moment
<b>Death Coil</b> es instantáneo: hace h: Death Coil is instant: the enemy runs in horror for 3 sec, takes damage and you heal for that much. Use it when Fear breaks and they're back on you, to stop a cast you can't stop otherwise, or to survive one more hit. In Classic it doesn't share diminishing returns with Fear, so they chain well; that is not confirmed yet in Forever. It still works on a warrior in Berserker Stance.
Soul Link: el demonio como escudo: Soul Link: your demon as a shield
Con <b>Soul Link</b> (Demonology), tu de: With Soul Link (Demonology), your demon takes 30% of the damage aimed at you and you both deal 3% more. It only works while the demon lives: watch its health and use Health Funnel (Improved Health Funnel lets you use it at any health with no threat). Priests and shamans can dispel it off the demon. If it dies, Fel Domination and resummon it almost instantly.
En JcJ no dejes al demonio en automático: In PvP, don't leave your demon on autopilot. With the Felhunter, save Spell Lock for the enemy's key spell (a heal or a crowd control): landed mid-cast it also locks that school for 6 sec. Devour Magic strips a magic effect off you or a buff off the enemy. With the succubus or incubus, Seduction (humanoids only) locks the enemy down: don't put damage effects on them first or they'll break it.
Cada golpe que recibes retrasa tus hechi: Every hit you take delays your cast-time spells. Forever's answers: the Voidwalker's Sacrifice gives you a shield, and while it holds you aren't pushed back; Fel Concentration (Affliction) gives Drain Life, Drain Soul and Wrack a 70% chance to ignore pushback. If a melee is on top of you, don't fight through a Fear cast: Death Coil or Howl of Terror (2 sec, up to 5 enemies within 10 yards) first.
Manda primero al demonio y espera a que: Send the demon in first and wait until the mob locks onto it. With the Voidwalker, Torment pulls it back if it turns on you. Don't open with Searing Pain (high threat) unless you are Demonology and need it for Demonic Brand.
Al subir: <b>Bane of Agony</b> y <b>Corr: While leveling: Bane of Agony and Corruption, then Drain Life to heal while they tick (Soul Siphon drains more for each Affliction effect on the target). Bane of Agony hits hardest at the end: don't refresh it early. If the mob is almost dead, wand it instead of adding another effect.
<b>Life Tap</b> cambia vida por maná, y: Life Tap turns health into mana, and in Forever Spirit boosts it. Use it on the move or between effects, whenever you have more health than mana; then refill health with Drain Life. You'll barely need to stop and eat or drink.
En mazmorras, <b>Banish</b> deja fuera d: In dungeons, Banish takes a demon or elemental out of the fight for up to 20 sec (it can't be damaged). Only Fear where there is room: a fleeing mob can run into another pack and bring it back. Curse of Recklessness stops it from fleeing, but also breaks your own Fear.
Con varios enemigos o en jefes con ayuda: On packs or bosses with adds, Tab between them and put Corruption and Bane of Agony on each; only on mobs that will live long enough for the full tick. The more Corruption effects you have running, the more often Nightfall procs (instant Shadow Bolt).
Movimiento con W y S, desplazamiento lat: Move with W and S, strafe on A and D and turn with the right mouse button: it lets you apply effects while backing off.
Macro de Fear al foco: <b>/cast [@focus]: Focus Fear macro: /cast [@focus] Fear. Set the second enemy as focus and fear it without losing your target.
Habilidades del demonio en tus teclas: <: Put your demon's skills on your own keys: a macro with /cast Spell Lock or /cast Seduction next to your spells, so you never click the pet bar.

<b>Hamstring</b><br>Ralentiza al enemigo:
Hamstring
Slows the enemy by 40% for 15 sec (45% at level 32, 50% at level 54); stops runners. Battle or Berserker Stance only.
Pegar y salir con el arma lenta: Hit and step out with a slow weapon
Con un arma lenta a dos manos (por ejemp: With a slow two-hander (say 3.6 speed) there are over 3 seconds between swings. Apply Hamstring (Battle or Berserker Stance, not Defensive): the target moves 50% slower for 15 sec. Let your auto attack land and, as soon as it does, step back or sideways so they have to chase you and can't hit back. Step in again right as your next swing is due (that's the swing timer). You lose very little damage and take far less; it works against other melee and against tough mobs while leveling.
No soltar al objetivo: Charge, Intercept: Stay glued: Charge, Intercept and Hamstring
Charge solo funciona fuera de combate, e: Charge only works out of combat, in Battle Stance (or Defensive with Vanguard) and from 8 to 25 yards: if you're too close, back up to 8 yards first. Mid-fight your gap closer is Intercept (Berserker Stance, 30 sec cooldown, 3 sec stun). As soon as you land, Hamstring and move to their back or flank rather than their front so they struggle to get away. With Improved Hamstring (Arms) each Hamstring can root them for 5 sec, so reapply it before it falls off.
Cambiar de actitud según lo que pide la: Swap stances to fit the moment
Cada actitud abre botones distintos: Bat: Each stance unlocks different buttons: Battle Stance for Overpower (after a dodge) and Charge; Berserker Stance for Intercept, Pummel and Berserker Rage; Defensive Stance for Disarm. In Forever Tactical Mastery is baseline and keeps 10 Rage when you swap (more with Improved Tactical Mastery), so swapping is cheap. Against rogues, who dodge a lot, stay in Battle Stance to hit Overpower the moment it lights up. Against a hard-hitting warrior or rogue, go Defensive and Disarm them for 10 sec.
Tienes dos cortes: <b>Pummel</b> (Berser: You have two interrupts: Pummel (Berserker Stance, 10 sec cooldown, locks that school for 4 sec) and Shield Bash (needs a shield, locks for 6 sec and, with Improved Shield Bash, silences for 3 sec). Save them for a heal, a fear or a Polymorph, not the first spell you see. Good casters juke: they start a spell and cancel it to bait your interrupt. Wait until the cast bar is past halfway, then interrupt, but not at the very last moment: Forever has spell batching (actions pressed almost together resolve together) and the spell may still go off. If you use a two-hander, a weapon swap macro lets you put the shield on just for Shield Bash.
<b>Berserker Rage</b> te hace inmune al: Berserker Rage makes you immune to fear and incapacitate effects for 10 sec (30 sec cooldown, Berserker Stance). Against warlocks and priests, press it as you see the Fear cast start or as the priest walks in for the scream, not after: once you're running scared you can't press it. If it's spare, use it anyway for the Rage. Keep in mind it doesn't help against stuns or roots.
En Arms, <b>Mortal Strike</b> reduce un: As Arms, Mortal Strike cuts healing taken by 50% for 10 sec on a 6 sec cooldown: keep it on whoever is self-healing or being healed. In battlegrounds, switch to the target that's about to die or to the healer keeping everyone up, not just whoever is nearest. A warrior hitting the enemy tank while it gets healed is wasting time.
Esconderse de los lanzadores: Break line of sight on casters
Contra magos, cazadores y brujos que te: Against mages, hunters and warlocks keeping you at range, don't run straight at them across open ground. Get behind a pillar, a house or a rock: if they can't see you they can't cast on you and have to come closer, which is when you Intercept or Charge. If you're slowed, break line of sight first and wait it out. With several enemies on you, Piercing Howl (Fury) dazes them all (50% slower for 6 sec).
Como Protection, el enemigo que no tiene: As Protection, any enemy you don't have threat on goes for the healer. Open with Rend or Sunder Armor on the main target (in Forever they tap the mob to you instantly) and hand out a quick Sunder Armor to each of the others with Tab. Thunder Clap and Demoralizing Shout hit everything at once and now work in Defensive Stance. If one slips away, Taunt (8 sec cooldown); if they all do, Challenging Shout.
Si tanqueas, gira al enemigo de espaldas: When tanking, turn the enemy away from the group: everyone else hits its back, where it can't parry or block, and its cleaves don't reach them. You face it head on, which is where your blocks, dodges and parries work (and with them Revenge and your shield Rage). As DPS, always hit from behind. Before the pull, check where the mob would run and keep clear of other packs.
<b>Slam</b> tarda 1,5 s en lanzarse y, s: Slam has a 1.5 sec cast and, without Improved Slam, delays your auto attack. Cast it right after your weapon swing lands, never just before, so the delay eats dead time instead of a swing. With Improved Slam (Arms) it no longer delays your weapon and you can use it any time.
Guardar ira y gastar la que sobra: Pool Rage and dump the excess
<b>Heroic Strike</b> y <b>Cleave</b> no: Heroic Strike and Cleave aren't instant: they replace your next weapon swing and fire when it lands; that swing also stops generating Rage, so they cost more than the tooltip says. Queue them only when you have spare Rage beyond your main strikes (Mortal Strike, Bloodthirst, Shield Slam or Revenge). As the target nears 20% health, stop spending and pool Rage to chain Execute. While leveling, do the opposite: if the mob will die to auto attacks, don't spend and carry the Rage into the next pull.
Los enemigos que lanzan hechizos se qued: Casting enemies stay at range and make you chase them. Hit or shoot them and step behind a corner, doorway or pillar: since they can't see you they have to walk over and end up bunched at your side. Then Thunder Clap, Demoralizing Shout and go. If one keeps casting, Shield Bash or Pummel forces it to come to you.
Gira con el botón derecho del ratón, no: Turn with the right mouse button, not arrow keys or A/D, and set A/D to strafe. Never backpedal to get away: it's very slow.
Una tecla por actitud cerca de WASD (por: Bind one key per stance next to WASD (for example Shift+1/2/3) and group the stance-locked abilities together, so you can stance dance without looking at your bars.
Macro de cambio de armas con /equip para: Make a weapon swap macro with /equip to go from your two-hander to weapon and shield: in Forever you can swap several weapons within one global cooldown. Use it for Shield Bash or Shield Wall.

En WoW Forever el oro cuesta más que en: Gold is harder to come by in WoW Forever than in Classic. During the beta Blizzard shut down the usual shortcuts: crafted goods sell to vendors for next to nothing, each creature can only be skinned once, and a vendor now caps the price of the most expensive materials. What still works is the classic approach: gather while you level, sell what other players need on the auction house, and don't overspend. Here's what to do at each level range, which professions pay, and what no longer works.
<b>La subasta cobra.</b> En Classic la c: The auction house takes a cut. In Classic your faction's auction house keeps 5% of every sale, and you lose the deposit if the item doesn't sell; the neutral one (Booty Bay, Gadgetzan, Everlook) charges a lot more. Forever hasn't announced any changes. Use short auctions, undercut by a little, and don't list anything worth less than the deposit.
<b>Mira el precio antes de vender al ven: Check the price before vendoring anything. Materials, cloth, supply crates and bind-on-equip greens are almost always worth more on the auction house. And in Forever, crafted goods barely sell for anything at a vendor.
<b>Gasta poco mientras subes.</b> Paga l: Spend little while leveling. Only buy the spell ranks you actually use, and don't buy auction house gear you'll replace in two levels: quests and dungeons will gear you.
<b>Guarda para la montura.</b> A nivel 4: Save for your mount. At level 40 riding costs 100 gold, plus 20 for a mount from the vendor; at level 60 it's 1,000 and 200. Honored with your home faction gives 10% off. Paladins and Warlocks get theirs through class quests.
<b>Dos de recolección para empezar.</b>: Start with two gathering professions. They don't cost money, they make it. Once you're 60 and have some gold, swap one for the crafting profession that pairs with the other.
<b>No compres oro.</b> Blizzard ya cerró: Don't buy gold. Blizzard already closed thousands of beta accounts for buying or selling gold and promises harsh penalties. Forever has no WoW Token and GDKP raids aren't allowed.
Una misión del primer día te deja elegir: A day-one quest lets you pick a manual (Wild Harvest, Mining for Dummies or Pelt Collecting for Beginners) that teaches the profession and gives +2 skill. Every starting zone has a junior trainer up to 75 and Poor Copper Vein nodes, though Blizzard reduced how many there are. Pick up everything you pass on the way to your quests.
En Forever el mineral se apila de 20 en: In Forever ore stacks to 20 (it used to be 10), so it takes half the bag space. Nodes respawn faster the more players are nearby. During the beta a Copper Bar often sold for less than its ore: sell the raw ore unless the bar is clearly worth more.
Cada bestia se desuella una sola vez y l: Each beast can only be skinned once, then it despawns, so there's no point waiting to skin after someone else. You can skin other players' kills once they've looted them. Besides regular leather you get new scarce materials like Pristine Leather, which sold for far more than Light Leather during the beta.
Los humanoides sueltan <b>Linen Cloth</b: Humanoids drop Linen Cloth and Wool Cloth: tailors need it to level and for the new reagent bags. Sell it in stacks on the auction house. Grey items go to the vendor: Forever's price cut targets crafted goods, not junk.
Vuelven los cajones de Season of Discove: The supply crates from Season of Discovery are back: they drop randomly in the world and ask for a bundle of materials. Once filled it binds to you, and you turn it in for Merchant's Favor and a bit of silver (Dokimi outside the Crossroads for Horde, Marcy Baker in Redridge for Alliance). Empty, it can be sold on the auction house to players chasing Favor. Compare both before you decide.
En Forever las pociones de sanación pasa: In Forever healing potions move to First Aid, a profession almost everyone levels. That pushes up demand for Peacebloom, Briarthorn and Bruiseweed, which used to sell only to alchemists. With Herbalism, sell these herbs rather than sitting on them if you don't need them.
<b>Tin Ore</b>, <b>Silver Ore</b>, <b>Ir: Tin Ore, Silver Ore, Iron Ore and Mithril Ore are in constant demand from blacksmiths and engineers. In Forever, new bonus ores also drop (Pyrite from copper, tin and iron; Bauxite from mithril) for new recipes. Keep them for the auction house: vendors pay very little for them.
Las recetas de Favor y los cajones de en: Favor recipes and supply crates call for Classic materials nobody used to want. Before vendoring something for copper, check whether it sells on the auction house: it's the easiest money you'll make without changing anything you do.
La pesca no ocupa hueco de profesión pri: Fishing doesn't use a main profession slot. Mid-level fish sell to players leveling Cooking, and you also fish up chests and rare items. In Classic, Oily Blackmouth and Firefin Snapper were good money from alchemists; Forever adds new uncommon and rare fish on top.
Los objetos verdes ligados al equiparse: Bind-on-equip greens sell to other players or get disenchanted; vendors pay little for them. If you're an enchanter, buy greens on the auction house that cost less than what you'd get from disenchanting them.
En Classic el pícaro roba cajas (junkbox: In Classic, Rogues lift junkboxes off humanoids with Pick Pocket, open them with Pick Lock and sell the contents; they also open boxes for other players for a tip. It's steady money, not big money. The Scarlet Monastery chest loop from the beta no longer works.
Llega al 40 con unos 120 de oro (100 de: Hit 40 with about 120 gold (100 for riding and 20 for the mount), or 108 if you're Honored. Riding makes leveling and gathering much faster, so it's the best purchase in the game. After that, start saving for the 1,200 at level 60.
<b>Mageweave Cloth</b> y <b>Runecloth</b: Mageweave Cloth and Runecloth drop from humanoids from 40 to 60 and always sell: bandages, bags and reputation turn-ins. In Forever tailors can also make Mageweave Reagent Bag and Runecloth Reagent Bag with Favor.
En Classic los elementales de fuego de B: In Classic, the fire elementals in Burning Steppes drop Essence of Fire and Heart of Fire, wanted by blacksmiths, alchemists and enchanters for level 60 recipes. It's one of the best-paying classic farms. It remains to be seen whether Forever's new recipes shift their price.
<b>Thick Leather</b> y <b>Rugged Leather: Leatherworkers burn through Thick Leather and Rugged Leather. In Un'Goro, devilsaurs give Devilsaur Leather, one of Classic's priciest leathers. In Forever beasts also drop Pristine Hide and other scarce materials.
Los cajones Expert (nivel 20) y Artisan: Expert (level 20) and Artisan (level 35) crates give more Favor. Fill them with what you gather and spend the Favor on recipes that sell (necklace enchants, armor kits, bags). That's how you turn cheap materials into things people actually buy.
Las primeras bandas abren el 9 de diciem: The first raids open on 9 December, and that's when flasks, elixirs, mana potions, oils (Wizard Oil, Mana Oil), sharpening stones and food spike in price. Stock up on materials before then: it's the safest money at 60.

Nobody pays more on the auction house, but selling a little under that price is still good money. The Bountiful Harvest Legacy perk gets you more of these materials.
Los encantamientos nuevos de Forever (<b: Forever's new enchants (Enchant Weapon - Revelation, Insight, the Enchant Necklace line) are only available to enchanters with enough Favor. They're applied in person: advertise in trade chat and charge for your work.

Mineral en montones de 20 y minerales de: Ore stacks to 20 and there are new bonus ores (Pyrite, Bauxite, Pitchblende). At 60, every crafting profession wants Thorium and Arcane Crystal. Sell ore, not bars, unless the bar is worth more. Confirmed in Forever
Va perfecta con cualquier clase que mate: A perfect fit for any class that kills beasts while leveling. Once per creature, but with new scarce materials (Pristine Leather, Pristine Hide, Pristine Scale) that sell well. At 60, Rugged Leather and Devilsaur Leather. Confirmed in Forever
Ya no sirve para hacer varitas y venderl: It no longer works for crafting wands to vendor. It earns in other ways: disenchanting greens (worth more as dust and essences), new Favor enchants only you can apply, and raid oils. Nerfed in Forever

With Favor, Elixir of the Grizzly and Major Frenzy Potion. Nerfed in Forever

<b>Fabricar varitas para el vendedor:</b: Crafting wands to vendor: In Classic, enchanters crafted wands and vendored them at a profit. In beta 4 Blizzard set every common and uncommon crafted wand to 1 copper, then in beta 5 gave them fixed, very low prices: Lesser Magic Wand 1s 10c (5s 8c in Classic), Greater Magic Wand 2s (15s 35c), Lesser Mystic Wand 4s 50c (35s 81c), Greater Mystic Wand 6s (52s 63c). It's no longer worth it. Wands can still go to other players on the auction house if anyone wants them.
<b>El truco del aceite de mago:</b> <b>M: The wizard oil trick: Minor Wizard Oil sold to vendors for 5s in Classic, more than its materials (Strange Dust and not much else). In Forever it sells for 1s: no longer profitable.
<b>Vender lo fabricado al vendedor:</b>: Vendoring crafted goods: In beta 6 Blizzard cut the vendor price of many profession items (weapons, armor, bars). The point is to stop gold being created out of thin air: what you craft is worth what another player will pay. Level your profession with things you'll use or that sell on the auction house, not for the vendor.
<b>Desollar dos veces:</b> En una versió: Double skinning: In one beta build several players could skin the same creature. Since beta 4 it's back to the original rule: one skin, then it's gone.
<b>Farmeo en masa con mago:</b> En Class: Mass mage AoE farming: In Classic, Mages gathered huge packs and killed them with Blizzard, thanks to Frost slows. During the beta Blizzard trimmed those slows (Improved Blizzard, Permafrost). Small pulls with Cone of Cold still work, but the huge Classic pulls don't.
<b>Bucles de la beta:</b> El bucle de co: Beta loops: The Rogue chest loop in Scarlet Monastery was closed by a beta hotfix. And the Bartering perk was wrongly discounting training and repairs: it now only discounts vendor purchases.
<b>Black Lotus y Arcane Crystal a precio: Black Lotus and Arcane Crystal at sky-high prices: In Classic they were among the most expensive things on the auction house. In the Forever beta a vendor sells them without limit at 50 gold, so that's their ceiling. They still make money, just not Classic money.
<b>Bandas GDKP:</b> Las bandas en las qu: GDKP raids: Raids where loot is auctioned for gold are banned in Forever. That gold doesn't exist: don't save up expecting to buy raid gear.

La mascota es la mitad del cazador. En W: Your pet is half of the hunter. WoW Forever keeps a system very close to Classic: you tame a beast, feed it, build its loyalty and teach it abilities you first learned by taming other beasts. What's new is in the families: almost all of them now have their own signature trick, there's a brand-new family (the fox) and pets scale with your gear. Every fact carries a status: forever (confirmed by Blizzard), beta (seen in the beta, which was capped at level 30, and may change on November 4) or classic (WoW Classic data that Forever hasn't confirmed yet).
A nivel 10 el instructor de cazadores te: At level 10 your hunter trainer starts a quest chain (the name depends on your race). You tame three local beasts, which teaches you Tame Beast; finishing the chain unlocks Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet. Call Pet brings it out and Dismiss Pet sends it away.
<b>Tame Beast</b> es una canalización de: Tame Beast is a 20-second channel from 30 yards that costs 60% of your base mana and drops your armor to zero while it lasts. It fails if the beast stops attacking you or takes damage. You can only tame beasts at or below your level (a Forever change), and you can't tame while you have a pet out or dismissed, or with a dead pet in the stable: revive it first. Use Aspect of the Monkey to dodge more during the channel and start at full health.
Una mascota feliz hace un 125 % de su da: A happy pet deals 125% of its damage, a content one 100% and an unhappy one 75%. Happiness drains slowly over time, drops sharply when the pet dies and loses 50 points every time you use Dismiss Pet. A freshly tamed pet is very unhappy, so feed it straight away. In the beta a bug made happiness drop only on death; we still have to see how it behaves at launch.
<b>Feed Pet</b> solo funciona fuera de c: Feed Pet only works out of combat, so feed before every long pull. The food must belong to its family's diet, and the closer it is to the pet's level, the more happiness it gives. Beast Lore (level 24) shows what any beast eats before you tame it, and hovering over the happiness icon shows your pet's diet. Always carry a stack of food at its level.
Loyalty is still in Forever. It has six ranks: Rebellious, Unruly, Submissive, Dependable, Faithful and Best Friend. Every new pet starts at Rebellious and climbs as you feed it and kill things together. More loyalty means more training points (TP) to buy abilities: a level 60 Best Friend pet has 300. A high-level beast you've just tamed can start with negative points; they come back on their own through feeding and fighting.
Enseñar habilidades: sí, hay que domar p: Teaching abilities: yes, you still tame to learn
Como en Classic, tú aprendes las habilid: As in Classic, you learn abilities from other pets yourself. Stable your pet, tame a beast that has the ability and rank you want, use it in combat until chat says you've learned it, then bring your pet back and teach it through Beast Training using its points. Each pet can have up to 4 active abilities. If it can't learn one, no TP cost shows up. Blizzard fixed beasts that taught ranks too high for their level, so some Classic rank sources may have changed.
Todas las familias aprenden <b>Bite</b>: Every family learns Bite or Claw (some get both) and Dash or Dive to move fast. Almost all have Cower to shed threat. The pet trainer in the capitals teaches Growl (threat; a new rank every 10 levels from 10), Great Stamina, Natural Armor and the resistances. Visit after leveling up. The trainer can also wipe abilities and refund points for a small fee; in the beta a full wipe also removed attack speed, so only unlearn what you need.
La mascota tiene su propia barra de expe: Your pet has its own experience bar: it gets 25% of what you earn from green or higher enemies, no rested or quest XP, and it stops at your level. New in Forever: it inherits part of your gear (10% of your attack power and your crit chance, whichever is higher between melee and ranged) plus expertise, but it no longer receives stat buffs from other players. Its focus now regenerates continuously.
<b>Mend Pet</b> (nivel 12, nuevo rango c: Mend Pet (level 12, a new rank every 8 levels) heals it while you channel. Revive Pet brings it back at 15% health, and a dead pet loses happiness. Eyes of the Beast (14) lets you steer it for 2 minutes and Scare Beast (14) fears a beast. Aggressive mode is back under the pet tab of your spellbook.
Puedes tener tres mascotas: una contigo: You can own three pets: one with you and two stabled, by buying the two extra slots from any friendly stable master. Use them to keep a damage pet and a tanky one, or to park yours while you tame another to learn an ability. Forever's slot prices haven't been published yet.
Dentro de una familia el daño está igual: Damage is evened out within a family: a fast pet hits more often but softer, so it makes no difference in dungeons. Speed matters in PvP: lots of quick hits push back enemy casts more. That's why hunters hunt for fast-attacking beasts (1.0 or 1.2 seconds instead of the usual 2.0).

En WoW Forever lo caro no es la montura,: In WoW Forever the expensive part isn't the mount, it's learning to ride: 100 gold at level 40 and 1,000 at level 60. That's why the warlock and paladin class mounts matter so much. Here's how to get them, what Blizzard has confirmed and what is still the Classic route, and how to save gold with reputation. Each entry has a status: forever (confirmed by Blizzard), beta (seen in the beta or in Forever guides, may change) or classic (how it worked in WoW Classic; Forever hasn't confirmed it yet).
<b>Nivel 40, Apprentice Riding</b>: 100: Level 40, Apprentice Riding: 100 gold to learn riding plus about 20 for the mount, for 60% extra speed. Save around 120 gold before 40.
<b>Nivel 60, Journeyman Riding</b>: 1.00: Level 60, Journeyman Riding: 1,000 gold to learn plus about 200 for the fast mount, for 100% extra speed.
La habilidad de montar es una sola para: Riding is a single shared skill learned from your race's trainer (most are in their capital or starting area). Humans have a second mount vendor in Menethil Harbor, and Skyborne train and buy from Genn Fairweather on Zephras Isle.
Para montar las monturas de otra raza de: To ride another race's mounts from your faction you need Exalted with that race (as in Classic).
Las monturas de los packs de Forever (po: Mounts from Forever's packs (for example the Cerulean Prideclaw in the Skyborne pack) sit in your collection, but you can only use them once you've learned riding in game.
No hay monturas voladoras ni escalado de: No flying mounts and no level scaling. There's a PvP mount at rank 11 of 14 and another (Reins of the Spectral Bear) on the Legacy reward track.
El talento Pursuit of Justice del paladí: The paladin talent Pursuit of Justice (+15%) and the Tauren racial Plainsrunning (+3% mounted, in Forever) stack with mount speed.
<b>Forever</b>: con reputación Honorable: Forever: Honored with your race's faction gives a 10% discount on the mount and on riding training. That's about 12 gold at 40 and about 120 at 60. (Warcraft Tavern's Forever data.)
<b>¿Más descuento con Reverenciado y Exa: More discount at Revered and Exalted? Not in original Classic (1.12): it was a flat 10% from Honored. The 5% (Friendly), 10% (Honored), 15% (Revered) and 20% (Exalted) scale arrived with The Burning Crusade patch 2.3. Forever hasn't said which one it uses; if it follows Classic, Revered and Exalted give nothing extra.
<b>Qué reputación cuenta</b>: la de la f: Which reputation counts: the faction of the vendor and trainer, who are your own race. A Human needs Stormwind; an Orc, Orgrimmar; an Undead, Undercity. Reputation with another city doesn't lower your mount's price.
<b>Rango de JcJ (Classic)</b>: en Classi: PvP rank (Classic): in Classic, PvP rank 3 gave another 10% off at your faction's vendors, on top of Honored. Forever has PvP ranks but hasn't confirmed this discount.
<b>Llegar a Honorable antes del 40</b>:: Reaching Honored before 40: do every quest in your starting zone and in the zone next to your capital; they give reputation with your city, and in practice many players hit Honored before 40 just by leveling. Forever adds new quests to every starting zone, so it should be even easier.
<b>Entregas de tela (Classic)</b>: en tu: Cloth donations (Classic): your capital takes a one-time donation per cloth type. Wool (A Donation of Wool, from level 12) asks for 60 Wool Cloth and gives 350 reputation; there are matching ones for silk, mageweave and runecloth. If you're close to Honored, the wool and silk ones are the quickest push. Forever hasn't confirmed they're unchanged.
<b>Para el nivel 60</b>: la entrega repe: For level 60: the repeatable runecloth turn-in (Additional Runecloth, 20 Runecloth for 75 reputation from level 50, in Classic) is the classic way to reach Honored or higher before paying the 1,000 gold.
