<b>Léelo antes de mirar las letras.</b>: Read this before looking at the letters. The beta only went to level 30, raids open on December 9 and there are no level 60 combat logs yet. These lists are our average of the provisional rankings published before launch: Seemeta (Oct 28) and RankedBoost (PvP, October), Noobtoboss's role lists (Oct 19) and a beta damage simulation from Oct 21. All of them are based on the beta client's talents and what each spec brings, not on real play. Each spec is compared within its role (tanks with tanks, healers with healers, damage with damage). Where sources disagreed, we averaged them. Treat it as a first impression: it will change once real data arrives, and we'll update it. Note: Icy Veins, one of the reference sites, has not ranked any Forever spec yet (all «TBD» as of October 26). We will update this once there is level 60 data.
¿Cuál es la clase más fácil para empezar: What's the easiest class to start with?
El cazador y el paladín. El cazador tien: Hunter and paladin. The hunter has a pet that takes the hits while it shoots from range; the paladin wears plate, heals itself and has a very short rotation. Both are forgiving of mistakes.
El cazador (Beast Mastery), en todas las: The hunter (Beast Mastery), on every list. Warlock and mage come next. Warrior and priest are the slowest solo, but they speed up a lot in a group. The gap between classes is a few days of playtime, not whether you reach 60.
¿Cuál es la mejor clase para JcJ?: What's the best class for PvP?
No hay una sola. Las listas provisionale: There isn't just one. Provisional lists agree on rogue (especially Subtlety), Frost mage and priest (Shadow and Discipline). In battlegrounds, druids are unmatched flag carriers and hunters control from range. Keep in mind nobody has played level 60 PvP in Forever yet.
Siempre faltan tanques y sanadores, así: Tanks and healers are always in short supply, so if you tank (warrior, paladin, druid) or heal (priest, shaman, paladin, druid) you'll find a group faster. Damage dealers are plentiful. Forever raids open on December 9.
Sí. Puedes reiniciar los talentos en el: Yes. You can reset talents at your trainer, and from level 40 there's dual spec: you save two builds and swap between them. So it's fine to level with one spec and play another at 60.
¿Debo elegir la rama que está arriba en: Should I pick the spec at the top of the list?
No hace falta. Las listas son teoría has: You don't need to. The lists are theory until there are level 60 logs, and any spec works in dungeons and early raids if you play it well. Pick what you enjoy: you'll be doing it for hundreds of hours.
¿Qué clase es mejor si juego poco tiempo: Which class is best if I don't have much time?
Una que suba sola sin descansos: cazador: One that levels solo without downtime: hunter or warlock thanks to their pets, or paladin, which almost never dies. They let you make the most of short sessions without looking for a group.
¿Qué clase es más versátil?: Which class is the most versatile?
El druida, que puede tanquear, curar y h: The druid, which can tank, heal and deal both melee and ranged damage. After that come paladin and shaman, with three roles each.

En WoW Forever el tope es 60 y no va a s: In WoW Forever the level cap is 60 and it is staying there, so everything you do once you ding counts for good. Raids open on December 9: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40). That gives you a few weeks to get your fast mount, collect your keys, run the level 60 dungeons and start the Onyxia chain. Every point is tagged: forever = announced by Blizzard or found in Forever's data; beta = tested in the beta and may change; classic = how it worked in WoW Classic, with nothing from Forever saying otherwise.
<b>1. Montura rápida (Journeyman Riding):
1. Fast mount (Journeyman Riding) Confirmed in Forever
At level 60 you can learn 100% riding: about 1000 gold for the training and 200 for the mount. Being Honored with your home city cuts the bill by 10%. Paladins and warlocks earn their class mount through quests. There are no flying mounts. If you're short on gold, farm dungeons and gathering first: the fast mount saves you hours on every trip for keys and quest chains.
<b>2. Empieza ya la cadena de Onyxia</b>:
2. Start the Onyxia chain right away Confirmed in Forever
To enter Onyxia's Lair every player needs the Drakefire Amulet in their bags. The chain is long, goes through several dungeons and elite quests, and it isn't account-wide at launch: each character does their own. Alliance starts with Helendis Riverhorn in Burning Steppes; Horde with Warlord Goretooth in Kargath (Badlands). Both end by killing General Drakkisath in Upper Blackrock Spire. Full steps are on our raids page.
<b>3. Las llaves de las mazmorras</b> <s:
3. Dungeon keys Classic data, unconfirmed
Grab your keys while you run the dungeons, not later: Shadowforge Key (Dark Iron Legacy quest, Blackrock Depths), Seal of Ascension (assembled inside Lower Blackrock Spire, opens Upper), Crescent Key (drops from Pusillin in Dire Maul East, opens West and North), Skeleton Key (The Key to Scholomance chain) and Key to the City (Magistrate Barthilas, Stratholme service gate). Without them you rely on a rogue or take the long way. Forever hasn't announced changes to these keys, and the items are still in the game data.
<b>4. Mazmorras de 60, en orden</b> <spa:
4. Level 60 dungeons, in order Classic data, unconfirmed
An order that makes every visit count: Blackrock Depths (key, half the Alliance Onyxia chain and the Thorium Brotherhood), Lower Blackrock Spire (seal and half the Horde chain), Dire Maul East (Crescent Key), Stratholme and Scholomance (Argent Dawn and gear) and finally Upper Blackrock Spire for Drakkisath. Note: in Forever most dungeon XP comes from quests, and the loot of the classic dungeons has been reworked and stays hidden until someone loots it.
<b>5. Reputaciones mientras juegas</b> <:
5. Reputation along the way Classic data, unconfirmed
Don't grind reputation on its own: pick it up on the way. Thorium Brotherhood in Blackrock Depths, Argent Dawn in Stratholme and Scholomance (with the Argent Dawn Commission equipped), Timbermaw Hold in Felwood and Winterspring, which is exactly the road to Mount Hyjal. If you have Legacy points, the Diplomat perk (5 points) gives 10% more reputation across your account.
<b>6. Conoce Monte Hyjal antes del 9-12<:
6. Learn Mount Hyjal before Dec 9 Confirmed in Forever
Mount Hyjal is Forever's new level 60 zone, and it's contested (you can fight the other faction there). You reach it from Winterspring, heading east through Darkwhisper Gorge. Both new raids are there: Hyjal Summit up top, next to Nordrassil, and Barrow Deeps underneath, with entrances from Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold. Scout it before raid day so you're not hunting for the door.
<b>7. Resistencia al fuego para Onyxia</:
7. Fire resistance for Onyxia Confirmed in Forever
Blizzard advises bringing fire resistance to Onyxia: it's a three-phase fight with lots of fire. The Drakefire Amulet itself gives +15 fire resistance. Keep any fire resistance pieces you find, and if you have Alchemy, Fire Protection Potion was the usual answer in Classic (its recipe in Forever is still unconfirmed).
<b>8. Consumibles: sin bufos de mundo de:
8. Consumables: no world buffs inside Confirmed in Forever
In Forever world buffs are removed when you enter dungeons and raids, so the Classic world-buff game is gone: what matters is what's in your bags. Carry health and mana potions, buff food and the elixirs for your role. Camping buffs (from professions) don't stack with the matching class buff. In the beta several class buffs became raid-wide (Battle Shout, druid auras, shaman totems).
<b>9. Profesiones al máximo</b> <span cl:
9. Max out your professions Confirmed in Forever
Taking a crafting profession to 300 earns Legacy points. Forever's high-end recipes cost Merchant's Favor and need reputation with the Azeroth Commerce Authority (Alliance) or Durotar Supply and Logistics (Horde): you raise it by filling supply crates. On top of that, high-end camping items drop in dungeons and raids, and some recipes need that station to craft.

10. Get your group ready for December 9 Confirmed in Forever
You need to be level 60 to enter the raids. Sizes are fixed (10, 20 and 40), with no flexible mode and no heroic or mythic difficulty, and all three reset weekly. Put your 10-player group for Barrow Deeps together first: it's the easiest raid to fill with friends.

<b>Nuestro consejo:</b> Hoy recomendaría: Our advice: Our pick today: always Questie, plus a route guide. If you don't want to pay, use RestedXP's free starter routes for the first levels (the most tested route from the beta) and Polestar after that, which is also available in Spanish. If you want a paid guide, RestedXP has the most Forever-specific route written right now; Zygor can't be judged until it comes out on November 4. None of them is ready for 35-60 yet: in the new zones, rely on Questie and the in-game map until they catch up.
<b>Variante hasta el 30 con Shifting Pow: Variant to 30 with early Shifting Power (a build seen in the beta, level cap 30): 5/5 Ferocity, 2/2 Feral Swiftness, 3/3 Feral Instinct, 2/2 Sharpened Claws, 3/3 Shredding Attacks, Shifting Power (25), 2/2 Blood Frenzy, 2/2 Savage Fury and Leader of the Pack at 30. You end up with a cat that is 30% faster, has Shifting Power, 9% more crit and crits that grant an extra combo point. Shifting Power trades mana for 40 Energy: use it when you drop below 50 Energy, never above, or the extra is wasted. The 30-60 plan above still works; only the order changes.
<b>Como oso (10-19)</b>: Maul sustituye: As a bear (10-19): Maul replaces your next auto-attack and Swipe does not, so Swipe and Demoralizing Roar are your core and Maul only goes out when you have Rage to spare. Enrage (12) trades armor for Rage to open a fight. If you are low, Nature's Grasp: the enemy gets rooted when it hits you, you step back and heal with Regrowth.
<b>Armas que puedes aprender</b>: dagas,: Weapons you can learn: daggers, fist weapons, one- and two-handed maces, staves and, new in Forever, polearms from level 20. No swords, axes or ranged weapons. Your race already knows some; the rest come from a weapon master. Each skill costs 10 silver from a capital-city weapon master and can be learned from level 1; polearms cost 1 gold and need level 20. Since in Forever your weapon adds damage in Bear and Cat Form, learn two-handed maces early and polearms at 20: you get more slow Strength or Agility weapons to choose from.
<b>No te saltes el último paso</b>: Tami: Don't skip the last step: Taming the Beast is three quests in a row. In each one you tame a different local beast with the rod, and that pet is only a trial: abandon it before taming the next. Once done you learn Tame Beast, Call Pet and Dismiss Pet, and you are sent to the hunter trainer in your capital (in Durotar, Thotar sends you to Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar). Many players never go and end up without Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet. After that, tame whichever beast you like.
<b>Armas que puedes aprender</b>: arcos,: Weapons you can learn: bows, crossbows, guns and thrown at range; daggers, fist weapons, one-handed axes and swords; and staves, polearms, two-handed axes and swords. You cannot use maces. Your race already knows some; the rest come from a weapon master. Each skill costs 10 silver from a capital-city weapon master and can be learned from level 1; polearms cost 1 gold and need level 20. First get all three ranged types (bow, crossbow and gun) so you can use the best one you find, since it is most of your damage. In melee slots, a two-hander with Agility and Stamina (staff or polearm) usually gives the most stats.
Desde el 15 de octubre, <b>Auto Shot</b>: Since 15 October, Auto Shot only fires after half a second standing still, as in original WoW. While kiting the rhythm is: stop, the shot goes off, strafe until the next one, stop again. If you never stop, no Auto Shot fires and you lose much of your damage. A Forever bonus: Auto Shot keeps firing while you cast Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot, so long casts cost you no shots. Easy maths: the time you can move between two shots is your weapon speed minus 0.5 seconds. With a 2.4 speed bow (Venomstrike, for example) you get 1.9 s to move after each shot; then stop for half a second and the next one fires.

Missile Barrage gives every Frostbolt a 20% chance to make your next Arcane Missiles free, half as long and firing every half second. When it procs, cast them; if the enemy is almost dead, finish it with your wand and save the proc for the next pull. The trade-off: Fingers of Frost comes later.

Trucos para todas las clases que ahorran: Tips for every class that save time and gold from day one: where to learn each weapon, how weapon skills work and how to get bags early. Anything that comes from the beta (level cap 30) is marked as such.
<img src=\"https://wow.zamimg.com/images: How weapon skills work
Cada tipo de arma es una habilidad apart: Each weapon type is a separate skill. Your race and class already know some; the rest are taught by a capital-city Weapon Master: 10 silver each from level 1, and polearms 1 gold from level 20. Wands need no training: mages, priests and warlocks have them built in. Check what you know in the character window's Skills tab, which lists every weapon with its value. A newly learned skill starts at 1 and rises on its own as you hit things with that weapon, up to 5 per level (5 at level 1, 300 at 60). With a low value you miss more and deal less damage, so before taking a new weapon into a dungeon, level it up a bit on easy enemies. In Forever no race raises weapon skill: the Orc (axes) and Human (swords) racials give crit instead.

El JcJ de WoW Forever mezcla lo clásico: PvP in WoW Forever blends the classic formula with new ideas: Ranks 1 to 14 and the old battlegrounds are back, but now there are seasons, two currencies (Honor and Rank Points) and a brand-new 15v15 battleground, Darkspear Islands. This page covers what is confirmed, what we saw in the beta and what we only know from Classic so far. Every section is tagged so you know how much to trust it.
Tipos de reino: Normal, JcJ, Rol y Rol-J: Ruleset types: Normal, PvP, RP and RP-PvP
En Forever no eliges un reino concreto,: In Forever you don't pick a specific realm, you pick a ruleset: Normal (world PvP is opt-in), PvP (in contested zones anyone can attack you at any time), RP, and RP-PvP, which Blizzard added at the end of the beta. Hardcore comes later. On the PvP ruleset each account can only have characters on one faction, and a PvP guild's faction is permanent. During name reservation Blizzard temporarily throttled new Horde characters on PvP because they heavily outnumbered the Alliance.
Honor y Puntos de rango: dos cosas disti: Honor and Rank Points: two separate things
El honor es la moneda: con él compras el: Honor is the currency: you spend it on PvP gear and rewards. You earn it by killing enemy players, finishing battlegrounds and doing PvP quests. Rank Points are what move you up the ranks, and they come from battlegrounds and PvP quests (world kills aren't on Blizzard's list). Both get a boost in the featured holiday-week battleground. During the beta the Honor cap went up from 15,000 to 25,000, and battleground Marks of Honor now stack to 30. The Legacy perk For Great Honor gives 10% more Honor.
Vuelven los 14 rangos con sus títulos de: All 14 ranks are back with their classic titles, up to High Warlord for the Horde and Grand Marshal for the Alliance. The big difference: there is no more weekly decay. Each season you start at Rank 1 and climb with Rank Points, which have a weekly cap (Blizzard hasn't given the number). Seasons last about 4 months, matching the big patches. Each season has a journey of weekly tasks (the Field of Honor Journey) that award Honor and Rank Points; three of them also grant a Legacy point. You can check your rank and points in the character window (C key), on the PvP tab.
Cada rango desbloquea algo: <b>1</b> tab: Every rank unlocks something: 1 tabard, 2 PvP trinket, 3 cloaks, 4 necklace, 5 combat potions, 6 another tabard, 7 battle standard, 8 epic bracer and belt tokens, 9 boots, 10 gloves, 11 mounts, 12 legs and shoulders, 13 chest and helm, 14 epic weapons. Reaching Ranks 3, 7, 10, 13 and 14 also gives Legacy points.
Con honor compras dos conjuntos: uno azu: Honor buys two sets: a blue one and an epic one. To get an epic piece you need the blue piece plus an Emboldened Seal, and that seal requires a minimum rank. Each epic slot also unlocks with an upgrade token at its rank (see the list above). During the beta the Honor prices of gear and tokens went up, most of them by 50%. There are new sets for specs that used to have nothing, like the Shaman, who gets a healer, a melee and a caster set. Battlegrounds also have reputation quartermasters with trinkets, rings, cloaks, weapons and armor.
Te apuntas hablando con un maestro de ba: You queue by talking to a battlemaster in any capital city (Darkspear Islands also has a portal at your faction's base in The Barrens). Brackets go in steps of ten: Warsong Gulch from level 10, Arathi Basin from 20, Darkspear Islands from 30, and Alterac Valley as a single 51-60 bracket. You can be matched with players from other rulesets (Normal, PvP, RP) but never Hardcore, and factions stay separate. Blizzard has said premades will face premades, so solo players and small groups shouldn't run into one.
15 vs 15 · niveles 30-39, 40-49, 50-59,: 15 vs 15 · levels 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60 Confirmed in Forever
Unas islas frente a la costa del Marjal: A set of islands off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. The Horde fights as the Darkspear Raiders (based at Merchant Coast in The Barrens) and the Alliance as the Theramore Expeditionary Force (based at Northwatch in The Barrens). There are four capture points: the more you hold, the faster you score. A flag spawns in the middle; carry it to a point your team controls for extra points. First team to 2,000 points wins. It plays a lot like Eye of the Storm from The Burning Crusade.
Tener dos puntos y defenderlos bien vale: Holding two points properly beats owning four for a minute and losing them all. Always leave someone on guard.
La bandera solo puntúa en un punto vuest: The flag only scores at a point you own: before you pick it up, check the map and agree where you'll take it.
Proteged al que lleva la bandera con san: Escort the flag carrier with heals and crowd control; a lone carrier is an easy kill.
Entregad las Marks of Honor en vuestra b: Turn in your Marks of Honor at your Barrens base: they give reputation, and at Exalted there's a short quest chain for the faction tabard. They now stack to 30.
Haced las misiones de campo de batalla d: Pick up the battleground quests at your base: they add reputation with the quartermaster, who sells trinkets, rings, cloaks and weapons.
10 vs 10 · niveles 10-19, 20-29, 30-39,: 10 vs 10 · levels 10-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60 Seen in the beta
Captura la bandera. Hay que entrar en la: Capture the flag. Get into the enemy base, take their flag and bring it back to yours while your own flag is still at home. First team to three captures wins.
Repartid el equipo: unos atacan, otros d: Split the team: some attack, some guard your flag and someone holds the middle. If everyone goes for the enemy flag, yours gets stolen.
El portador ideal aguanta y se mueve ráp: The best carrier is tough and fast: a Druid in Travel Form, a well-armored Warrior or anyone with a healer at their side.
Si las dos banderas están fuera, nadie p: If both flags are out, nobody can score: you have to kill the enemy carrier to return yours.
Avisad por el chat dónde va el portador: Call out where the carrier is going (tunnel, ramp, graveyard) in chat: it saves a lot of deaths.
15 vs 15 · niveles 20-29, 30-39, 40-49,: 15 vs 15 · levels 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60 Seen in the beta
Control de recursos. Hay cinco bases: St: Resource control. There are five bases: Stables, Blacksmith, Lumber Mill, Gold Mine and Farm. Every base you hold builds resources over time, and the more bases you hold, the faster they come. In Classic the first team to 2,000 resources won (the Forever number isn't confirmed yet). In the beta you could enter from level 20, and the zone quests gave 200 reputation with The League of Arathor or The Defilers.
Three well-defended bases wins the game. Don't chase a fourth if it leaves one of yours empty.
Una bandera tarda un rato en pasar a vue: A flag takes a while to turn: any hit resets it. Always interrupt whoever is capping.
Al empezar, el Blacksmith del centro dec: At the start, the Blacksmith in the middle matters a lot: whoever holds it reaches everything faster.
No dejéis a una sola persona en una base: Never leave one person alone on a base against a Rogue or Druid: put two there and call out as soon as someone shows up.

La gran batalla de 40 contra 40. Cada ba: The big 40v40 battle. Each side has reinforcements that drop when a player dies and when they lose towers, bunkers or captains. You win by killing the enemy general (Drek'Thar or Vanndar Stormpike) or by draining the other side's reinforcements. These are the Classic rules: it couldn't be tested in the beta because the level cap was 30.
En Forever no compensa quedarse solo en: In Forever it doesn't pay to only play Alterac: Blizzard has rebalanced Honor so the other battlegrounds give as much or more. Rotate between them.
Las torres y búnkeres restan muchos refu: Towers and bunkers take a big chunk of the enemy's reinforcements: burning them is usually worth more than brawling mid-road.
Defended vuestros cementerios cercanos a: Defend the graveyards near your general: lose them and you respawn far away while the enemy gets there first.
Antes de ir a por el general, matad o de: Before pulling the general, deal with his guards and captains; otherwise the fight drags on and you lose it.
En las reglas JcJ te pueden atacar en cu: On the PvP ruleset anyone can attack you in contested zones without warning. On Normal you only fight if you turn PvP on yourself (or attack someone who has it on).
Blizzard no va a proteger a los personaj: Blizzard won't protect low-level characters from level 60s on PvP rulesets: they'll only step in for cheating. If you pick PvP, expect some rough encounters while leveling.
Matar jugadores enemigos da honor, pero: Killing enemy players gives Honor, but according to Blizzard Rank Points only come from battlegrounds and PvP quests. To climb ranks, world PvP alone won't do it.
Las capas reparten a la gente por grupos: Layering splits players into groups, and the game tries to keep you with your guild and friends. After the huge fights in the beta (Orgrimmar, Ashenvale), Blizzard is looking at letting the servers detect those battles and give them more capacity.
Cuidado con lo que activa el JcJ: en la: Watch what flags you: in the beta Sap was fixed to flag the Rogue when used on a flagged target. In Dalaran (Alterac) the guards attack the Horde on sight, though the dungeon is still open to both factions.
Hay una arena de duelos en un cráter del: There's a duel arena in a crater on Mount Hyjal (it was used for the tournament), but Blizzard says it isn't ready yet. Regular duels work anywhere.
El rango ya no cae cada semana ni depend: Rank no longer decays every week or depends on competing with the rest of the server: you climb with Rank Points, up to a weekly cap, and start over each season.
El honor ya no es lo que te sube de rang: Honor no longer climbs your rank: it's a currency to buy gear, with a cap (25,000 in the beta).
Temporadas de unos 4 meses con tareas se: Seasons of about 4 months with weekly tasks, plus Legacy points for ranks, battleground reputations and season weeks (12 PvP challenges in total, which don't count on Hardcore).
Equipo en dos pasos: conjunto azul con h: Two-step gear: a blue set for Honor and an epic version through Emboldened Seals and rank tokens. There are new sets for specs that had none.
Nuevo campo de batalla de 15 contra 15,: New 15v15 battleground, Darkspear Islands (30-60), with capture points and a flag.
El honor está repartido para que Alterac: Honor is rebalanced so Alterac Valley isn't the only option worth playing.
Grupos hechos contra grupos hechos, y ca: Premades face premades, and battlegrounds mix players from different rulesets (but not Hardcore).
Los críticos ya no pierden fuerza en JcJ: Critical strikes no longer have reduced effect in PvP (beta change).
Sin arenas: Blizzard prefiere peleas de: No arenas: Blizzard prefers 10v10 and 15v15 fights, though it hasn't ruled them out entirely.

Cuántos Puntos de rango pide cada rango: How many Rank Points each rank needs and the size of the weekly cap. One guide estimates 24,750 points for Rank 14; Blizzard hasn't confirmed it.
Cuánto honor da cada victoria, muerte o: How much Honor each win, kill or quest gives, and the final prices of gear and seals.
Fecha de inicio de la primera temporada: Start date of the first season and which battleground gets each holiday week.
Si Arathi Basin y Alterac Valley mantien: Whether Arathi Basin and Alterac Valley keep their Classic numbers (resources to win, reinforcements) or change.
Los desafíos de grupo contra grupo en ca: Group-vs-group battleground challenges (no Honor) and the Hyjal duel arena: Blizzard has mentioned them for after launch, with no date.

Cada monstruo lleva una lista de quién l: Every mob keeps a list of who annoys it most: damage and healing add threat. It attacks whoever is on top. Tanks have high-threat tools (Sunder Armor, Bear Form, Righteous Fury). To pull a mob off the tank you must exceed their threat by 10% in melee range and by 30% at range. Taunt, Growl and the like match the top threat and put you first. As DPS, start a couple of seconds after the tank. Forever has a built-in threat option: search "Threat" in the settings (Aggro Display). Full detail (taunts, threat drops, pets, totems and meters) in the "Threat (aggro): how it works" group.
En JcE cada monstruo lleva una lista con: In PvE every mob keeps a list with the threat of each player and pet in the fight, and it attacks whoever is on top. In Classic each point of damage is one point of threat; healing is half a point per point healed, split across every mob fighting you; gaining mana, rage or energy adds a little too (Forever confirms it: it removed the threat two paladin talents caused when restoring mana). The mob doesn't switch the moment you pass the tank: you have to beat them by 10% in melee range and by 30% at range. That's why a mage casting from afar survives longer than a rogue glued to the boss, and why walking in close is dangerous when your threat is high: once you're in melee the margin drops from 130% to 110% and the mob turns on you without you doing anything else. These numbers come from Classic; Blizzard hasn't said Forever changes them.
Cada clase multiplica la amenaza que gen: Every class multiplies the threat it makes depending on its stance, form or aura. Confirmed in the Forever client: the warrior's Defensive Stance +30% (and the Defiance talent, up to 15% more with a shield); Bear Form and Dire Bear Form +50% (it was +30% in Classic); the paladin's Righteous Fury +90% threat on Holy attacks. Tank abilities also add bonus threat on top of their damage: Sunder Armor, Revenge, Shield Slam and Heroic Strike for warriors; Maul, Lacerate and the new Primal Bite for bears (Forever doubled its threat); Holy Shield for paladins. In Classic, Battle Stance and Berserker Stance make less threat (×0.8), and so do Cat Form and rogues (×0.71); Forever hasn't announced changes there. During the beta some debuffs caused no threat (Demoralizing Shout, Demoralizing Roar, Faerie Fire in bear form); the patch notes say they're fixed.
Las provocaciones de verdad son <b>Taunt:
The real taunts are the warrior's Taunt (Defensive Stance) and the bear druid's Growl; in Forever both have an 8 sec cooldown (10 in Classic). They set your threat equal to the top of the list and force the mob to attack you for a few seconds; after that you must keep generating threat or you'll lose it again. They do nothing if the mob is already hitting you, and they can miss: if you see "Resisted", go to plan B. Mocking Blow (warrior, Battle Stance) and the area ones, Challenging Shout (10 yards in Forever) and Challenging Roar, only force the mob onto you for 6 sec without raising your threat to the top: they're for saving a teammate while you regain control. Paladins have no taunt in Forever (Righteous Defense doesn't exist; it came in TBC). Pets have their own: the hunter's Growl and the warlock Voidwalker's Torment and Suffering, see "Pet tanking". Macro to taunt the enemy under your mouse without changing target: #showtooltip Taunt
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Taunt (swap Taunt for Growl as a druid).
Si vas a quitarle el monstruo al tanque,:
If you're about to pull the mob off the tank, stop for a moment or shed threat. Feign Death (hunter): wipes you from the list, but it can be resisted (a talent raises its hit chance); if the mob keeps coming, it failed. Fade (priest): enemies ignore you for 10 sec; in Classic the threat comes back when it ends, so it buys time rather than clearing it (Forever removed the Improved Fade talent). Feint (rogue): lowers your threat permanently and can be used every 10 sec; on bosses, use it whenever it's ready. Cower (cat druid and hunter pet) and Disengage (hunter; Forever doubled how much it drops and it no longer takes you out of combat, it only stops your auto-attack). Salvation (paladin): in Forever it replaces Blessing of Salvation, cuts threat by 30% for 1 hour and doesn't take a blessing slot; Mass Salvation (level 60) gives it to a whole class and Revoke removes it (never on the tank). Talents that lower threat: the priest's Silent Resolve (all spells in Forever) and the mage's Frost Channeling, among others. The warlock's Soulshatter isn't in Forever (it came in TBC): warlocks can only pause or use low-threat spells. Hunter macro: #showtooltip Feign Death
/stopattack
/petfollow
/cast Feign Death (your pet stays on the list; /petfollow pulls it out of the fight). More in the hunter macros.

Las mascotas del cazador y los demonios:
Hunter pets and warlock demons have their own threat. For solo play it's the comfiest thing in the game: the pet goes in first and you start dealing damage a couple of seconds later. The hunter pet's Growl isn't a taunt like the warrior's: in Classic it's a big chunk of threat every 5 sec. The warlock's Voidwalker does taunt with Torment, and Suffering taunts everything within 10 yards. How to manage it: right-click Growl (or Torment) on the pet bar to toggle autocast (the spinning golden border). Solo: on. In a group with a tank: off, or your pet will steal the tank's mobs. If a mob comes after you, Intimidation (hunter) or Distracting Shot help you hand it back to the pet or the tank. Macros: /petautocasttoggle Growl (toggles autocast without hunting for the button) and #showtooltip Growl
/petattack [@mouseover,harm,nodead][]
/cast Growl (sends the pet to the enemy under your mouse, or your target, and Growls when it arrives).
Entre jugadores no hay amenaza: Taunt, G: There's no threat between players: Taunt, Growl or Mocking Blow on a player doesn't force them to do anything, and Fade or Feint don't take you off their screen. What does follow threat is pets (hunter and warlock) when you leave them on their own (Defensive or Aggressive): they pick targets like a mob. That's why the shaman's Stoneclaw Totem, which taunts creatures within 8 yards, can pull enemy pets off the shaman for a few seconds; that's how it works in Classic, and we haven't seen it confirmed against player pets in Forever. The owner gets the pet back with an attack command. If you have a pet: near a shaman, don't leave it on autopilot, give the order yourself (/petattack). If you're a shaman: drop Stoneclaw as soon as a pet chases you, and use the time to get away.
Los tótems del chamán son unidades con m: Shaman totems are units with very little health: in the Forever client, Grounding, Earthbind and Tremor have 5 health, so any hit breaks them; Stoneclaw is tougher (206 to 486). Sending your pet is the cheapest answer: the shaman loses the slow (Earthbind), the fear protection (Tremor; great news for warlocks and priests) or the spell shield (Grounding). Totems are awkward to Tab to: turn on enemy nameplates (V key) and hover them. Macro: /petattack [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] (the pet attacks the totem under your mouse without changing your target; with nothing under the mouse, it attacks your target). You can also focus it (/focus) and use /petattack [@focus,harm,nodead]. No pet: shoot it (Shoot, Throw, Auto Shot) or hit it once; area damage (Arcane Explosion, Consecration, Holy Nova, Thunder Clap, Multi-Shot, Volley, Fire Nova...) wipes them without aiming.

El <b>Grounding Totem</b> (Tótem derriba:
Grounding Totem takes the next harmful spell cast at the shaman or their party near the totem (it doesn't redirect area spells). According to the beta patch notes, in Forever it breaks after redirecting one spell; it has 5 health, lasts 45 sec and the shaman can drop it again after 15 sec. The rule: never waste your big spell on it (Polymorph, Fear, Death Coil, Pyroblast). Break it first. Hunter, the "Growl" trick: send your pet at the totem with Growl or a normal attack; with 5 health it dies on the first hit. Macro, with your mouse over the totem: #showtooltip Growl
/petattack [@mouseover,harm,nodead][]
/cast Growl. What's certain is that the pet's hit breaks it; whether the totem "eats" the Growl itself isn't confirmed in Forever (in modern WoW it did by mistake and was fixed in 2015). Casters: first cast rank 1 of a cheap instant at your target, and once the totem is gone, the real spell. Mage: Fire Blast (Rank 1). Priest: Shadow Word: Pain (Rank 1). Warlock: Curse of Weakness (Rank 1). Druid: Moonfire (Rank 1). Shaman: Earth Shock (Rank 1), though it shares a cooldown with the other shocks. Mage example: #showtooltip
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Fire Blast(Rank 1). Warriors, rogues and paladins have no cheap ranged spell: break the totem with a hit or with Shoot or Throw. The "(Rank 1)" format is how Classic macros work; Forever's spellbook shows ranks the same way, but we haven't tested it in a Forever macro.

En Classic, cuando el atacante y su obje: In Classic, when the attacker and their target are both moving, melee reach grows by about 2.7 yards (the figure comes from Classic guides; Blizzard never gave one). You feel it in PvP: a warrior chasing you keeps landing Hamstring when you look out of range, and the hunter's dead zone gets bigger. To the game, jumping also counts as moving, so jumping while you chase or flee can trigger that margin. What jumping does not do is extend the range of ranged spells: 30 or 40 yards stays 30 or 40, jump or not. What jumping does give casters is something else: casting instants mid-air while you turn (jump-turn, under "Movement and kiting"). Blizzard hasn't said whether leeway works the same in Forever: test it in a duel before relying on it.

Forever trae su propio indicador: en las: Forever has its own indicator: search "Threat" in the Options and the Aggro Display setting comes up (confirmed in the beta patch notes). To see numbers for the whole group there are add-ons with a Forever file (checked on CurseForge on 30 October 2026): ThreatClassic2, the usual Classic one, which now has a "forever" build; ForeverThreat, Omen-style and made for Forever; and a few smaller ones (ThreatLedger, Forever Simple Threat). Their authors say they read threat from the game itself, not the combat log, which is what Forever restricts for add-ons. One of them warns that on some enemies (bosses) the game hides the numbers and the meter can only sort the group. Rule for DPS: if your bar gets close to the tank's, stop or drop threat; remember the mob switches once you pass 110% or 130%.

Respuestas cortas a lo que más se pregun: Short answers to the most common Hunter questions in WoW Forever. Each one is tagged: forever (confirmed by Blizzard for the game), beta (seen in the beta or its client, which capped at level 30; it may change) or classic (WoW Classic info Forever hasn't touched, but not verified). For pets in depth see the Pets guide; for talents, rotation and builds, see the Hunter guide.
¿En Forever el cazador sigue gastando mu: Do Hunters still use ammo in Forever?
Sí. Cada disparo gasta una flecha o una: Yes. Every shot uses an arrow or a bullet, and if you run out your shots stop working. Buy several stacks whenever you pass a vendor. Seen in the beta
Flechas para arcos y ballestas; balas pa: Arrows for bows and crossbows; bullets for guns. If you switch weapon type, switch ammo too. Classic data, unconfirmed
¿Para qué sirve el carcaj o la bolsa de: What does a quiver or ammo pouch do?
Ocupa un hueco de bolsa y solo guarda mu: It takes a bag slot and only holds ammo (quiver for arrows, pouch for bullets). In Classic it also gave ranged attack speed. Some Forever databases show it unchanged from Classic, but Blizzard hasn't confirmed it. Always use the largest one you have. Classic data, unconfirmed
¿La calidad de la munición cambia el dañ: Does better ammo mean more damage?
Sí: en Classic la munición suma daño a c: Yes: in Classic ammo adds damage to every shot, so use the highest level you can equip. Engineering crafts good bullets. Classic data, unconfirmed
¿Por qué no sale el Auto Shot cuando me: Why doesn't Auto Shot fire while I move?
Desde el 15 de octubre, <b>Auto Shot</b>: Since 15 October, Auto Shot needs half a second standing still before each shot, like original WoW. The rhythm is: stop, it fires, move, stop again. Instant shots still work on the move. Seen in the beta
Los disparos van de 8 a 35 metros. Entre: Shots work from 8 to 35 yards. Between melee range and 8 yards you can neither shoot nor hit. Get out with Wing Clip and a few steps, or turn on «Auto Attack/Auto Shot» in Options so the game swaps between melee and shooting for you. Seen in the beta
¿Aimed Shot sigue siendo un talento?: Is Aimed Shot still a talent?
No. Lo aprenden todos los cazadores en e: No. Every Hunter learns it from the trainer at level 20. It has a 2-second cast and shares a 6-second cooldown with Multi-Shot. Confirmed in Forever
¿Aimed Shot me corta el Auto Shot?: Does Aimed Shot clip my Auto Shot?
No: en Forever el <b>Auto Shot</b> sigue: No: in Forever Auto Shot keeps firing while you cast Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot. Cast it whenever it's ready, no timing tricks needed. Seen in the beta
¿Qué puedo lanzar mientras corro?: What can I use while running?
Todo lo instantáneo: <b>Arcane Shot</b>,: Anything instant: Arcane Shot, Concussive Shot, Multi-Shot, stings, Summon Hawk and traps. What won't go off on the move is Auto Shot and anything with a cast time. Seen in the beta
¿Se puede disparar más lejos?: Can I shoot from further away?
Sí, con Marksmanship: <b>Hawk Eye</b> su: Yes, with Marksmanship: Hawk Eye adds 6 yards to your ranged weapon and Sniper Shot (the final talent) fires from 45 yards and gives your next 3 shots 10 extra yards for 10 seconds. Seen in the beta
¿Qué aspecto llevo puesto?: Which aspect should I keep on?
Solo puedes tener uno. <b>Aspect of the: You can only have one. Aspect of the Hawk for ranged fighting; Aspect of the Monkey (more dodge) before 10 or when you're being hit; Aspect of the Beast as Survival (in Forever it adds melee attack power); Aspect of the Wild (level 46) when the group needs Nature resistance. Seen in the beta
<b>Aspect of the Cheetah</b> (nivel 20): Aspect of the Cheetah (level 20) gives you 30% speed; Aspect of the Pack (level 40) gives it to your nearby group. With either, any hit dazes for 4 seconds: drop them before a fight and don't use Pack in a dungeon near enemies. Seen in the beta
Muestra en el minimapa un tipo de criatu: It shows one creature type on the minimap: Beasts (level 1), Humanoids (10), Undead (18), Hidden (24), Elementals (26), Demons (32), Giants (40) and Dragonkin (50). Only one at a time. As Survival, Improved Tracking (new) adds 5% damage to the tracked type. Seen in the beta
Se aprende a nivel 30 y tiene 30 segundo: You learn it at 30 and it has a 30-second cooldown. Enemies drop you and your threat is wiped, but it can be resisted. Leave it on for 6 minutes and you really die. In Forever you no longer need it to lay traps. Seen in the beta
¿Qué hace Eyes of the Beast?: What does Eyes of the Beast do?
Desde el nivel 14 controlas a la mascota: From level 14 you take control of your pet and see through its eyes at any range. In Forever it lasts 2 minutes (1 in Classic). Handy for scouting or pulling from afar. Seen in the beta
Los dos salen a nivel 32 en el cliente y: Both show up at level 32 in the client and reveal hidden or invisible enemies within 10 yards for 30 seconds. Flare has a 15 sec cooldown; Enchanted Flare (new) has 30 sec but also wards off magical darkness. How they coexist at launch is still unconfirmed. Seen in the beta
¿Existen Wyvern Sting y Scatter Shot?: Do Wyvern Sting and Scatter Shot exist?
Wyvern Sting is not in Forever. Scatter Shot is, but it is now a Marksmanship talent: a 4-second disorient at 15 yards that breaks on any damage. Seen in the beta
¿Scorpid Sting sigue bajando Fuerza y Ag: Does Scorpid Sting still lower Strength and Agility?
No. En Forever (nivel 22) baja un 2 % la: No. In Forever (level 22) it lowers the target's chance to hit by 2% for 20 seconds. Seen in the beta
¿Las trampas se pueden poner en combate?: Can I lay traps in combat?
Sí. Es uno de los grandes cambios de For: Yes. It is one of Forever's big changes: no need to leave combat or Feign Death first. Confirmed in Forever
¿Cuántas trampas puedo tener a la vez?: How many traps can I have out?
Dos: una de fuego (<b>Immolation</b> o <: Two: one Fire (Immolation or Explosive) and one Frost (Freezing or Frost). Each trap stays on the ground for 1 minute and has a 30-second cooldown. Seen in the beta
¿A qué nivel llega cada trampa?: At what level does each trap come?
<b>Immolation Trap</b> a 16, <b>Freezing: Immolation Trap at 16, Freezing Trap at 20, Frost Trap at 28 and Explosive Trap at 34. Fire traps now scale with your attack power. Seen in the beta
¿Cuánto congela Freezing Trap?: How long does Freezing Trap last?
Hasta 10, 15 o 20 segundos según el rang: Up to 10, 15 or 20 seconds by rank (levels 20, 40 and 60), and Clever Traps (Survival) adds 30%. Any damage breaks the ice, including your pet or a damage-over-time effect. Seen in the beta
Talento de Survival: quien pisa tu tramp: A Survival talent: whoever triggers your trap is rooted for 5 seconds. With Frost Trap it only fires on activation, not every tick, and it has diminishing returns in PvP. Seen in the beta
¿Cuándo tengo mascota?: When do I get a pet?
A nivel 10, con la cadena de misiones de: At level 10, through the trainer's quest chain. Don't skip the last step: visiting the trainer in your capital, who teaches Feed Pet, Revive Pet and Beast Training. Full details are in the Pets guide. Confirmed in Forever
¿Qué mascota es mejor para subir?: Which pet is best for leveling?
Felino si quieres daño; jabalí, oso o to: A cat for damage; a boar, bear or turtle for staying power. The family is what matters, since each has its own trick. Full table in the Pets guide. Confirmed in Forever
¿Puedo domar una bestia de más nivel que: Can I tame a beast above my level?
No: en Forever <b>Tame Beast</b> no func: No: in Forever Tame Beast doesn't work on beasts higher level than you. Seen in the beta
Mi mascota no ataca sola, ¿dónde está el: My pet won't attack on its own. Where is Aggressive mode?
En la pestaña de mascota del libro de he: In the pet tab of your spellbook. In dungeons Defensive or Passive is safer, so it doesn't pull on its own. Seen in the beta
¿Por qué mi mascota hace poco daño?: Why is my pet doing so little damage?
Casi siempre es la felicidad: contenta p: Almost always happiness: a happy pet hits at 125%, an unhappy one at 75%. Feed it food from its diet near its level, out of combat. Also check it has its latest ability ranks. Confirmed in Forever
¿Qué rama elijo para subir?: Which spec should I level as?
Beast Mastery: la mascota tanquea y desd: Beast Mastery: your pet tanks and from 25 you add two hawks with Summon Hawk. Once the tree is done at 40, points go into Marksmanship. Point order is in the Hunter guide. Seen in the beta
Sí, desde el nivel 40 en el instructor d: Yes, from level 40 at your class trainer: you save two builds and swap between them, for example one for dungeons and one for PvP. Seen in the beta
Talento nuevo de Marksmanship: un 20 % m: A new Marksmanship talent: 20% more damage with all attacks while you have no pet out. The most-planned Marksmanship and Survival builds for 60 take it. For leveling, keep your pet. Seen in the beta
Sí, en Forever es la rama de melé del ca: Yes, in Forever it is the Hunter's melee tree: Strider Kick, Lacerate, Mongoose Bite with Expose Prey, and Predator's Edge (50% more off-hand damage if you dual-wield). You need a good melee weapon. Seen in the beta
¿Cuánto cuesta cambiar los talentos?: How much does a respec cost?
En Classic el precio sube con cada cambi: In Classic the price rises with each respec and drops over time. In the beta it cost 1 silver as a temporary measure; the launch price hasn't been published. Classic data, unconfirmed
¿Qué estadística busco?: Which stat should I look for?
Agilidad ante todo: da poder de ataque a: Agility first: it gives ranged attack power and crit. Then hit (up to 9% against bosses). As Marksmanship, Intellect matters too, since Careful Aim turns it into attack power. Seen in the beta
Como en Classic, a nivel 40. Hasta enton: As in Classic, at level 40. Until then, leather. Don't swap a good leather piece for a worse mail one: Agility matters more than armor type. Classic data, unconfirmed
Arcos, ballestas, armas de fuego y arroj: Bows, crossbows, guns and thrown; daggers, fist weapons, axes and swords; staves and polearms. No maces. Learn all three ranged types from a weapon master so you can use the best one you find. Seen in the beta
¿Importa el arma de melé si juego a dist: Does my melee weapon matter if I play ranged?
Solo por sus estadísticas: busca un arma: Only for its stats: look for a two-hander with Agility and Stamina. Its damage only matters if you play Survival. Seen in the beta
Peletería y Desuello: equipo de cuero co: Leatherworking and Skinning: Agility leather gear from low levels (the Brawler's Leather Helm stood out in the beta) and hides from everything you kill. Engineering and Mining if you're into PvP: bullets, scopes and gadgets. Seen in the beta
Cocina para la comida que da bonificació: Cooking for buff food (and pet food), Fishing for gold and food, and First Aid, which also makes healing potions in Forever. With your pet tanking or an enemy frozen, you have time to bandage. Seen in the beta
¿Cómo sobrevivo antes del nivel 10?: How do I survive before level 10?
Dispara desde lejos y aléjate cuando se: Shoot from range and back off when they close in. From 8, Concussive Shot slows them. Aspect of the Monkey helps you dodge the hits that land. Seen in the beta
¿Cada cuánto voy al instructor?: How often should I visit the trainer?
Cada dos niveles: casi todo sube de rang: Every two levels: most spells rank up on even levels. Also learn new ranks of your pet's abilities. Seen in the beta
Mientras la mascota remata al primero, p: While your pet finishes the first one, put Serpent Sting on the next or leave a fire trap for it. Always keep mana for a crowd control or Feign Death if things go wrong. Seen in the beta
¿Por qué el enemigo viene a por mí y no: Why does the enemy come for me instead of my pet?
Porque disparas demasiado pronto. Deja q: Because you shoot too early. Let your pet land two or three hits first. If it still comes, Disengage (it sheds twice the threat in Forever) and let your pet take it back. Seen in the beta
Come comida que dé bonificación, lleva a: Eat buff food, carry water for your level and, if you stop by a campfire, call your pet there so it gets the camping buff too. Seen in the beta
¿Qué hace el cazador en grupo?: What is the Hunter's job in a group?
Daño a distancia, <b>Freezing Trap</b> p: Ranged damage, Freezing Trap to control one enemy, and group buffs: Hunter's Mark, Trueshot Aura (Marksmanship, now raid-wide) and Aspect of the Wild. Seen in the beta
¿Qué hago con la mascota en una mazmorra: What do I do with my pet in a dungeon?
Quítale <b>Growl</b> de lanzamiento auto: Turn off Growl autocast so it doesn't steal mobs from the tank, set it to Defensive or Passive and send it with /petattack to the tank's target. If it takes area damage, Mend Pet. Classic data, unconfirmed
¿Para qué sirve Hunter's Mark en grupo?: What does Hunter's Mark do in a group?
Sube el poder de ataque a distancia de t: It raises the ranged attack power of everyone attacking the marked target and lets you see it even in stealth. Only one mark fits per target: agree with the other Hunters. Seen in the beta
Sí. En el cliente de Forever se aprende: Yes. In the Forever client it's learned at level 60: it removes one Frenzy effect from an enemy, at 8-35 yards with a 20-second cooldown. In Classic it was a tome dropped in Molten Core; in Forever it hasn't been checked in game yet. Seen in the beta
Espera a que el tanque tenga al enemigo: Wait until the tank has the mob before using Multi-Shot or Volley. If it turns on you, Feign Death wipes your threat and Disengage lowers it in melee range. Distracting Shot does the opposite: it builds threat to peel a mob off a healer in an emergency. Seen in the beta
No. Misdirection llegó con The Burning C: No. Misdirection came with The Burning Crusade and isn't in Forever's spellbook. Seen in the beta

Todo su daño depende de alcanzarte. <b>C: All his damage depends on reaching you. Concussive Shot, Frost Trap and Wing Clip to keep range, and Intimidation or a bird of prey's disarm (Mine!) when he gets there. If he sticks again, Freezing Trap at your feet and reset.
Aguanta mucho y se cura: <b>Viper Sting<: Tough and self-healing: Viper Sting drains his mana and a crocolisk with Dismember cuts his healing. Don't stay close, since his stun is short-range. It's a long fight: watch your own mana.
Lo peligroso es la apertura. Lleva <b>Tr: The opener is the danger. Keep Track Hidden on, and once you spot him, Hunter's Mark and Flare so he can't hide. Serpent Sting stops him from restealthing. If he sticks to you, Freezing Trap or Scatter Shot, then get range.
<b>Viper Sting</b> en cuanto puedas: sin: Viper Sting as soon as you can: without mana he can't heal. Your pet on him pushes back casts, and a bat's Sonic Blast slows them. Stay out of his fear range and shoot from afar.
Manda la mascota a romper sus tótems y p: Send your pet to break his totems and use Viper Sting so he can't heal or spam shocks. If he plays melee, treat him like a warrior: range and traps.
Quiere congelarte y alejarse. Quédate fu: He wants to freeze you and run. Stay outside his Frost Nova range, use Viper Sting to drain his mana and keep your pet on him to disrupt casts (a bat is ideal). Save Feign Death for when he's finishing a long cast.
Mata o controla primero a su demonio y m: Kill or control his demon first and keep your pet on him to push back casts. Viper Sting takes the mana he converts from health, and Dismember cuts what he heals by draining.
Cada cambio de forma le cuesta maná: <b>: Every shapeshift costs him mana: Viper Sting leaves him without options. Concussive Shot and Frost Trap against cat and travel form, and Dismember against his heal-over-time. Freezing Trap works on any form.
Gana quien controle la distancia. Métete: Whoever controls range wins. Either get into his dead zone along with your pet or outrange him; Viper Sting drains his mana and killing his pet first often pays off. Break line of sight when he casts Aimed Shot.

Vuelven los 14 rangos con sus títulos de: All 14 ranks are back with their classic titles, up to High Warlord for the Horde and Grand Marshal for the Alliance. The big difference: there is no more weekly decay. Each season you start at Rank 1 and climb with Rank Points, which have a weekly cap (Blizzard hasn't given the number). Seasons last about 4 months, matching the big patches. Each season has a journey of weekly tasks (the Field of Honor Journey) that award Honor and Rank Points; three of them also grant a Legacy point. La mascota no es solo daño: es tu primer: Your pet is not just damage: it is your first line of control. When a melee goes for you, send it in with /petattack. As Beast Mastery, Intimidation makes its next hit stun for 3 sec: that is your window to run. A bird of prey with Mine! disarms warriors and rogues for 3 sec. Before Freezing Trap or Scatter Shot, pull your pet back (/petfollow) or it will break the control. Against a warlock or hunter, killing their pet first is often right. That is also why Lone Wolf rarely pays off in PvP: 20% extra damage does not make up for losing your first line of control.

Cada tipo de arma es una habilidad apart: Each weapon type is a separate skill. Your race and class already know some; the rest are taught by a capital-city Weapon Master: 10 silver each from level 1, and polearms 1 gold from level 20. A newly learned skill starts at 1 and rises on its own as you hit things with that weapon, up to 5 per level (5 at level 1, 300 at 60). With a low value you miss more and deal less damage, so before taking a new weapon into a dungeon, level it up a bit on easy enemies. La clase que cambia de forma y la que má: The shapeshifter, and the class Forever changed the most (Wild Growth, Lacerate, Revive…). It's slow until Cat Form at 20, then it moves along nicely. It's the most versatile class, but you juggle mana, rage and energy and must know when to shift.
El druida es la clase que cambia de form: The druid is the shapeshifting class: it casts as a Moonkin, fights as a cat, tanks as a bear and heals with heal-over-time effects. Forever gives it a lot: Omen of Clarity and Nature's Grasp become baseline, forms now benefit from your weapon and consumables, and you get Primal Bite, Lacerate, Shifting Power, Wild Growth and Revive. Heads-up: on 30 October the server data reworked the Feral and Restoration trees (Berserk is gone; Bloom and Predatory Discipline are in) with no Blizzard notes, so it may still change. It suits players who want to do everything with one character and don't mind lots of buttons.

En Classic, el gato salía y volvía a ent: In Classic, cats dropped and re-entered Cat Form to get free energy from Furor (powershifting). In Forever that no longer gives energy: Furor only restores what you had. Its replacement is Shifting Power: it turns mana into 40 energy without leaving form (a level 40 talent; since 30 October it has an 8 sec cooldown, down from 16; it costs the same as entering Cat Form). Use it when you drop below about 50 energy, never at full (it won't let you). Drink mana potions and Thistle Tea without leaving form to keep it going.
En Forever el oso genera un 50 % más de: In Forever bear forms generate 50% more threat and get double rage from crits. Open with Faerie Fire (it now generates threat in bear), then Primal Bite (from 40) on cooldown and Lacerate up to 5 stacks. On packs, Swipe (3 targets). Maul replaces your next white hit and that hit no longer gives rage, so only use it with spare rage. Turn the boss to face away from the group; Growl (8 sec) to pick one back up and Challenging Roar if several get loose.
Como sanador, cura antes de que haga fal: As a healer, heal before it's needed: Rejuvenation on the tank right before the pull and on whoever is about to take damage. Don't refresh it early. In Forever HoTs from several druids stack and can crit, and Swiftmend (every 15 sec) is your quick burst heal; per the 30 October tooltip, it consumes the Rejuvenation or Regrowth it uses. With Bloom, let your HoTs run out on their own: when they end they heal based on your Spirit. Wild Growth (3 sec cast since 30 October) when several people are about to take damage, and Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch to save someone. Reflection keeps 50% of your mana regen going while you cast.
El Cooldown Manager de Forever ya funcio: Forever's Cooldown Manager already supports druids: keep Barkskin, Nature's Grasp, Shifting Power, Frenzied Regeneration and Bash in view.
El 30-10 los datos del servidor cambiaro: On 30 October the server data changed the Feral and Restoration trees with no Blizzard notes: Berserk, Improved Shifting Power and Gift of the Earthmother are gone, Furor and Heart of the Wild swap trees, and Primal Bite and Shifting Power drop to row 7. The most planned level 60 builds from the beta (11/5/35 Restoration, 9/42/0 Feral and 36/0/15 Balance) no longer fit as they were, and we will redo them once there is data. On top of that nobody has reached 60 yet and raids open on 9 December 2026: what follows are priorities, not final builds.
